tokens_por_doc=[tok(t) for t in textos]
todos=[w for ts in tokens_por_doc for w in ts]
N=len(todos); V=len(set(todos))
print(f"CORPUS: {len(DOCS)} documentos, {N} tokens, {V} vocabulario")

# ===== EULER: leyes de escala observadas =====
freq=Counter(todos)
ranks=sorted(freq.values(),reverse=True)
xs=[math.log(r) for r in range(10,min(2000,len(ranks)))]
ys=[math.log(ranks[r-1]) for r in range(10,min(2000,len(ranks)))]
n=len(xs); sx=sum(xs); sy=sum(ys); sxx=sum(x*x for x in xs); sxy=sum(x*y for x,y in zip(xs,ys))
zipf=(n*sxy-sx*sy)/(n*sxx-sx*sx)
# Heaps
checkpoints=[]; seen=set()
for i,w in enumerate(todos,1):
    seen.add(w)
    if i%2000==0: checkpoints.append((i,len(seen)))
hx=[math.log(a) for a,_ in checkpoints]; hy=[math.log(b) for _,b in checkpoints]
n2=len(hx); heaps=(n2*sum(a*b for a,b in zip(hx,hy))-sum(hx)*sum(hy))/(n2*sum(a*a for a in hx)-sum(hx)**2)
print(f"EULER  | Zipf exponente = {zipf:.3f}  (lenguaje natural tipico ~ -1)")
print(f"EULER  | Heaps exponente = {heaps:.3f}  (tipico 0.4-0.7)")

# ===== vectores TF-IDF =====
df=Counter()
for ts in tokens_por_doc:
    for w in set(ts): df[w]+=1
vocab=[w for w,c in freq.items() if c>=5 and df[w]>=2]
vidx={w:i for i,w in enumerate(vocab)}
M=np.zeros((len(DOCS),len(vocab)))
for i,ts in enumerate(tokens_por_doc):
    c=Counter(ts)
    for w,k in c.items():
        if w in vidx: M[i,vidx[w]]=(1+math.log(k))*math.log(len(DOCS)/df[w])
M/= (np.linalg.norm(M,axis=1,keepdims=True)+1e-12)
S=M@M.T  # similitud coseno

# ===== POINCARE: la trayectoria y su recurrencia =====
vel=[1-S[i,i+1] for i in range(len(DOCS)-1)]
imax=int(np.argmax(vel))
theta=np.median(S[np.triu_indices(len(DOCS),1)])
R=(S>theta).astype(int)
rec_rate=R[np.triu_indices(len(DOCS),2)].mean()
# retornos: doc mas similar no-adyacente
retornos=[]
for i in range(len(DOCS)):
    sims=[(S[i,j],j) for j in range(len(DOCS)) if abs(i-j)>2]
    retornos.append(max(sims)[1])
print(f"POINCARE | velocidad media={np.mean(vel):.3f} max={max(vel):.3f} en el salto {DOCS[imax]}->{DOCS[imax+1]}")
print(f"POINCARE | tasa de recurrencia (theta=mediana)={rec_rate:.3f}")
print(f"POINCARE | ejemplo de retorno: {DOCS[-1]} vuelve cerca de {DOCS[retornos[-1]]}")

# ===== RIEMANN: espectro del campo =====
ev=np.linalg.eigvalsh(S)[::-1]
print(f"RIEMANN | autovalores top: {ev[0]:.2f}, {ev[1]:.2f}, {ev[2]:.2f} | gap relativo (l1-l2)/l1={(ev[0]-ev[1])/ev[0]:.3f}")
# modo principal
u=np.linalg.eigh(S)[1][:,-1]
pesos=sorted(zip(np.abs(u),DOCS),reverse=True)[:3]
print(f"RIEMANN | el modo-1 (tema dominante) carga mas en: {[d for _,d in pesos]}")
# estadistica de espaciamientos sobre grafo de co-ocurrencia
top=[w for w,_ in freq.most_common(350)]
tidx={w:i for i,w in enumerate(top)}
W=np.zeros((350,350))
for ts in tokens_por_doc:
    for a in range(len(ts)):
        if ts[a] in tidx:
            for b in range(a+1,min(a+6,len(ts))):
                if ts[b] in tidx and ts[a]!=ts[b]:
                    W[tidx[ts[a]],tidx[ts[b]]]+=1; W[tidx[ts[b]],tidx[ts[a]]]+=1
d=W.sum(1); Dm=np.diag(1/np.sqrt(d+1e-12)); L=np.eye(350)-Dm@W@Dm
lam=np.sort(np.linalg.eigvalsh(L))
mid=lam[len(lam)//5:-len(lam)//5]  # centro del espectro
s=np.diff(mid); s=s[s>1e-12]
r=np.minimum(s[1:],s[:-1])/np.maximum(s[1:],s[:-1])
print(f"RIEMANN | <r> espaciamientos = {r.mean():.4f}  [Poisson=0.3863 | GOE=0.5307]")

# ===== GAUSS: estructura contra el nulo hipergeometrico =====
K=100
tops=[set(w for w,_ in Counter(ts).most_common(K)) for ts in tokens_por_doc]
Vtot=len(set().union(*tops))
mu=K*K/Vtot
var=K*(K/Vtot)*(1-K/Vtot)*((Vtot-K)/(Vtot-1))
zs=[]
for i in range(len(DOCS)):
    for j in range(i+1,len(DOCS)):
        t=len(tops[i]&tops[j]); zs.append((t-mu)/math.sqrt(var))
print(f"GAUSS  | overlap medio={np.mean([len(tops[i]&tops[j]) for i in range(len(DOCS)) for j in range(i+1,len(DOCS))]):.1f} de {K} | nulo mu={mu:.1f}")
print(f"GAUSS  | z-score medio contra el nulo = {np.mean(zs):.1f} sigma (min={min(zs):.1f}, max={max(zs):.1f})")

D.2 — la_orilla_experimentos.py

Los trece experimentos de LA ORILLA (cap. 28): sumas exactas contra asintóticas, CRP, Pitman–Yor, el sello, Stirling, el latido log-periódico, Kac, y el teorema de la orilla con sus tres políticas de memoria.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
LA ORILLA — los experimentos.

Teoría exacta del océano de tipos, el lector con bolsillo finito
y la frontera de lo cognoscible. Cada experimento imprime
PREDICHO (la fórmula derivada en la_orilla.md) vs MEDIDO (la máquina).

Instrumentos por visión:
  EULER    — E1 constante de Karlin, E2 la escalera y el impuesto, E4 el polo doble.
  GAUSS    — E5 exactitud, E6 Mittag-Leffler y el no-autopromedio, E6b el contraste,
             E7 el sello (perfil invariante), E8 Ewens/Stirling exacto.
  RIEMANN  — E3 el latido log-periódico (polos complejos de la zeta del océano).
  POINCARÉ — E9 Kac exacto, E10 el teorema de la orilla (Saber_LRU=(2-2^{1/a})W),
             E11 precisión de Che, E12 FIFO, E13 la escalera LRU:
             c_k(a) = (-1)^k Δ^{k+1}[j^{1/a}](0)  (diferencias finitas).

Requisitos: numpy, scipy.  Ejecución: python3 la_orilla_experimentos.py
Tiempo aproximado: 2–4 minutos.
"""
import numpy as np, math, random
from collections import OrderedDict, deque, Counter
from itertools import permutations
from math import gamma, log, factorial
from scipy.stats import poisson
from scipy.special import gamma as cgamma, digamma
from scipy.integrate import quad

SEP = "-" * 78

def zipf_universe(alpha, m):
    i = np.arange(1, m + 1, dtype=np.float64)
    w = i ** (-alpha); Z = w.sum()
    return w / Z, Z

def t_char(hfun_sum, W):
    """Resuelve hfun_sum(t) = W por bisección (t = tiempo característico)."""
    lo, hi = 1.0, 1e14
    for _ in range(300):
        mid = math.sqrt(lo * hi)
        if hfun_sum(mid) < W: lo = mid
        else: hi = mid
    return math.sqrt(lo * hi)

# ============================ EULER ============================
print(SEP); print("EULER — contar exactamente")

# --- E1: constante de Karlin  C1 = Gamma(1-1/a)/zeta(a)^(1/a) ---
print("\nE1  descubrimiento V(t) ~ C1 t^{1/a} sobre océano Zipf-a  (suma exacta vs asíntota)")
for alpha in (1.5, 2.0, 3.0):
    p, Z = zipf_universe(alpha, 10**7)
    for t in (10**5, 10**6):
        Vex = np.sum(1.0 - np.exp(-t * p))
        Vas = gamma(1 - 1/alpha) / Z**(1/alpha) * t**(1/alpha)
        print(f"    a={alpha} t={t:.0e}: exacto={Vex:9.1f}  predicho={Vas:9.1f}  ratio={Vex/Vas:.4f}")

# --- E2: la escalera C_k = Gamma(k-1/a)/(k-1)!  y el impuesto 1-1/(ak) ---
print("\nE2  la escalera de verificación: N_k(t) = C_k (t/zeta)^{1/a},  C_k = Gamma(k-1/a)/(k-1)!")
alpha = 1.5
p, Z = zipf_universe(alpha, 10**7); t = 10**6; lam = t * p
for k in (1, 2, 3, 4, 5):
    Nk = np.sum(poisson.sf(k - 1, lam))
    pred = gamma(k - 1/alpha) / factorial(k - 1) * (t / Z)**(1/alpha)
    print(f"    k={k}: exacto={Nk:8.1f}  predicho={pred:8.1f}  ratio={Nk/pred:.4f}")
print("    impuesto C_{k+1}/C_k = 1 - 1/(a k):",
      " ".join(f"k={k}:{1-1/(alpha*k):.4f}" for k in (1, 2, 3, 4)))

# --- E4: el polo doble es el logaritmo (CRP): E V_n = th(psi(th+n)-psi(th)) ---
print("\nE4  CRP(theta): E V_n = theta[psi(theta+n)-psi(theta)]  (el logaritmo como polo doble)")
theta = 5.0
for n in (10**3, 10**5):
    EV = np.sum(theta / (theta + np.arange(n)))
    pred = theta * (digamma(theta + n) - digamma(theta))
    print(f"    n={n}: suma={EV:.4f}  fórmula digamma={pred:.4f}  |  EV - th*ln n = {EV - theta*log(n):+.4f}"
          f"  (constante predicha n→∞: -th*psi(th) = {-theta*digamma(theta):+.4f})")

# ============================ GAUSS ============================
print(); print(SEP); print("GAUSS — la ley exacta, la fluctuación y el sello")

# --- E5: simulación vs suma exacta ---
print("\nE5  V(t) simulado sobre Zipf vs suma exacta binomial")
alpha, m, t, reps = 1.5, 10**6, 10**5, 20
p, Z = zipf_universe(alpha, m); cum = np.cumsum(p)
rng = np.random.default_rng(90261)
Vs = [len(np.unique(np.searchsorted(cum, rng.random(t)))) for _ in range(reps)]
Vex = np.sum(1 - (1 - p)**t)
print(f"    sim={np.mean(Vs):.1f}  exacta={Vex:.1f}  dif%={100*(np.mean(Vs)/Vex-1):+.3f}")

# --- E6: Mittag-Leffler, no-autopromedio, la sombra larga ---
print("\nE6  PY(d,theta): V_t/t^d -> S con E S^p = G(th+1)G(th/d+p+1)/(G(th/d+1)G(th+pd+1))")
def py_paths(d, theta, T, npaths, seed):
    r = np.random.default_rng(seed); V = np.ones(npaths); snap = {}
    for n in range(1, T):
        V += (r.random(npaths) < (theta + d * V) / (theta + n))
        if n + 1 in (200, T): snap[n + 1] = V.copy()
    return snap
T, npaths = 20000, 6000
for d, theta in ((0.5, 0.0), (0.5, 1.0)):
    snap = py_paths(d, theta, T, npaths, 777)
    S = snap[T] / T**d
    mom = lambda pw: gamma(theta+1)*gamma(theta/d+pw+1)/(gamma(theta/d+1)*gamma(theta+pw*d+1))
    print(f"    PY({d},{theta}): E S={S.mean():.4f} pred={mom(1):.4f} | E S^2={np.mean(S**2):.4f} pred={mom(2):.4f}"
          f" | E S^3={np.mean(S**3):.4f} pred={mom(3):.4f}")
    print(f"      CV del límite = {S.std()/S.mean():.3f} (>0: NO autopromedia)"
          f"  |  corr(V_200, V_20000) = {np.corrcoef(snap[200], snap[T])[0,1]:.3f} (la sombra larga)")
Vs = [len(np.unique(np.searchsorted(cum, np.random.default_rng(1000+r).random(30000)))) for r in range(60)]
Vs = np.array(Vs)
print(f"    contraste, universo FIJO Zipf: CV(V_t) = {Vs.std()/Vs.mean():.4f} (→0: SÍ autopromedia)")

# --- E7: el sello — perfil p_r(d) = d*G(r-d)/(r! G(1-d)), invariante en theta ---
print("\nE7  el sello de Pitman: fracción de tipos vistos r veces -> p_r(d), independiente de theta")
def py_full(d, theta, n, seed):
    rr = random.Random(seed); counts = [1]; nonfirst = []
    for n_act in range(1, n):
        V = len(counts); x = rr.random() * (theta + n_act)
        if x < theta + d * V: counts.append(1)
        else:
            y = x - (theta + d * V)
            j = nonfirst[rr.randrange(len(nonfirst))] if y < len(nonfirst) else rr.randrange(V)
            counts[j] += 1; nonfirst.append(j)
    return counts
for theta in (1.0, 40.0):
    d = 0.5; cnts = py_full(d, theta, 10**6, 42)
    K = len(cnts); tab = Counter(cnts)
    fr = [tab.get(r, 0)/K for r in (1, 2, 3)]
    pr = [d*gamma(r-d)/(factorial(r)*gamma(1-d)) for r in (1, 2, 3)]
    print(f"    PY(0.5,{theta:>4}): K={K:5d}  medido=({fr[0]:.4f},{fr[1]:.4f},{fr[2]:.4f})"
          f"  predicho=({pr[0]:.4f},{pr[1]:.4f},{pr[2]:.4f})")

# --- E8: Ewens / Stirling exacto ---
print("\nE8  ley exacta de la imaginación: P(V_6=k) = |s(6,k)| th^k/(th)^(6), th=2")
theta, n, runs = 2.0, 6, 400000
stir = {1: 120, 2: 274, 3: 225, 4: 85, 5: 15, 6: 1}
rise = 1.0
for j in range(n): rise *= (theta + j)
rr = random.Random(9); cnt = Counter(); part_cnt = 0
for _ in range(runs):
    counts = []
    for n_act in range(n):
        if rr.random() * (theta + n_act) < theta: counts.append(1)
        else:
            x = rr.random() * n_act; acc = 0
            for j, c in enumerate(counts):
                acc += c
                if x < acc: counts[j] += 1; break
    cnt[len(counts)] += 1
    if sorted(counts) == [1, 1, 2, 2]: part_cnt += 1
for k in range(1, 7):
    print(f"    k={k}: medido={cnt[k]/runs:.5f}  exacto={stir[k]*theta**k/rise:.5f}")
p_part = 720/rise * theta**2/2 * (theta/2)**2/2
print(f"    partición (2,2,1,1): medido={part_cnt/runs:.5f}  exacto={p_part:.5f}")

# ============================ RIEMANN ============================
print(); print(SEP); print("RIEMANN — los polos de la zeta del océano son los fenómenos")

# --- E3: el latido log-periódico (universo geométrico) ---
print("\nE3  universo jerárquico p_i ~ q^i: V(t) = ln t/ln(1/q) + oscilación de periodo ln(1/q)")
q = 0.05
pg = (1-q) * q**np.arange(40); pg /= pg.sum()
us = np.linspace(log(10), log(1e8), 4000)
V = np.array([np.sum(1 - np.exp(-math.exp(u) * pg)) for u in us])
A = np.vstack([us, np.ones_like(us)]).T
coef, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(A, V, rcond=None)
res = V - A @ coef
print(f"    pendiente: medida={coef[0]:.4f}  predicha 1/ln(1/q)={1/log(1/q):.4f}")
# ajuste sinusoidal del periodo por barrido fino
best = (1e9, None)
for P in np.linspace(2.0, 4.5, 2501):
    w = 2*math.pi/P
    B = np.vstack([np.cos(w*us), np.sin(w*us), np.ones_like(us)]).T
    r2 = np.sum((res - B @ np.linalg.lstsq(B, res, rcond=None)[0])**2)
    if r2 < best[0]: best = (r2, P)
Pfit = best[1]
w = 2*math.pi/Pfit
B = np.vstack([np.cos(w*us), np.sin(w*us), np.ones_like(us)]).T
cf = np.linalg.lstsq(B, res, rcond=None)[0]
amp_med = math.hypot(cf[0], cf[1])
s1 = 2j*math.pi/log(1/q)
amp_pred = 2*abs(cgamma(-s1))/log(1/q)
print(f"    periodo:  medido={Pfit:.3f}  predicho ln(1/q)={log(1/q):.3f}")
print(f"    amplitud: medida={amp_med:.4f}  predicha 2|Gamma(-s1)|/ln(1/q)={amp_pred:.4f}")

# ============================ POINCARÉ ============================
print(); print(SEP); print("POINCARÉ — el retorno: Kac, el horizonte y la orilla")

# --- E9: Kac exacto en la cadena del bolsillo ---
print("\nE9  Kac: E[retorno a un estado del bolsillo] = 1/pi(estado)   (W=3, m=6, p~1/i)")
m6, W3 = 6, 3
w6 = np.arange(1, m6+1, dtype=float)**(-1.0); pk = w6/w6.sum()
states = [tuple(s) for s in permutations(range(m6), W3)]
idx = {s: i for i, s in enumerate(states)}
Tm = np.zeros((len(states), len(states)))
for s in states:
    for j in range(m6):
        ns = (j,) + tuple(x for x in s if x != j) if j in s else (j,) + s[:-1]
        Tm[idx[s], idx[ns]] += pk[j]
v = np.ones(len(states))/len(states)
for _ in range(4000): v = v @ Tm
s0 = (0, 1, 2)
rng = np.random.default_rng(3); cumk = np.cumsum(pk)
reqs = np.searchsorted(cumk, rng.random(4_000_000))
cur = (5, 4, 3); last = None; rets = []
for nstep, j in enumerate(reqs):
    j = int(j)
    cur = ((j,) + tuple(x for x in cur if x != j)) if j in cur else ((j,) + cur[:-1])
    if cur == s0:
        if last is not None: rets.append(nstep - last)
        last = nstep
print(f"    predicho 1/pi = {1/v[idx[s0]]:.2f}   medido = {np.mean(rets):.2f}  ({len(rets)} retornos)")
lg = sum(math.log(40-k) for k in range(12))
print(f"    bolsillo W=12 sobre m=40: |estados| ~ 10^{lg/math.log(10):.1f} => el retorno colectivo es cosmológico;")
print(f"    los tipos retornan en 1/p_i (rápido). Memoria individual recurrente, memoria colectiva irreversible.")

# --- E10 + E13: el teorema de la orilla ---
print("\nE10 el teorema de la orilla:  Saber_LRU = (2-2^{1/a})·W   |   Saber_ventana = (1-1/a)·W")
def lru_sim(p, W, tC, seed, mult=30, k_max=4):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed); cum = np.cumsum(p)
    total, warm = int(mult*tC), int(8*tC)
    reqs = np.searchsorted(cum, rng.random(total))
    cache = OrderedDict()           # tipo -> aciertos desde inserción
    last2 = {}                      # tipo -> anteúltima llegada (para el conteo ventana)
    lastt = {}
    fills = np.zeros(k_max); nsnap = 0; win2 = 0.0
    step = max(1, int(tC/4))
    for nstep, x in enumerate(reqs):
        xi = int(x)
        if xi in cache:
            cache[xi] += 1; cache.move_to_end(xi)
        else:
            cache[xi] = 0
            if len(cache) > W: cache.popitem(last=False)
        last2[xi] = lastt.get(xi, -10**18); lastt[xi] = nstep
        if nstep >= warm and nstep % step == 0:
            nsnap += 1
            hh = np.fromiter(cache.values(), dtype=np.int64)
            for k in range(1, k_max+1): fills[k-1] += np.sum(hh >= k)
            win2 += sum(1 for tt in last2.values() if tt > nstep - tC)
    return fills/nsnap, win2/nsnap
print("    a     W     tC     LRU_med  LRU_pred  vent_med  vent_pred   c_med   c_pred")
lru400 = None
for alpha, W in ((1.5, 100), (1.5, 200), (1.5, 400), (1.5, 800), (2.0, 150), (3.0, 60)):
    p, Z = zipf_universe(alpha, 10**5)
    tC = t_char(lambda t: np.sum(1-np.exp(-p*t)), W)
    fills, win2 = lru_sim(p, W, tC, seed=int(alpha*1000+W))
    c_lru = 2 - 2**(1/alpha); c_win = 1 - 1/alpha
    if (alpha, W) == (1.5, 400): lru400 = (fills, p, tC, W)
    print(f"   {alpha:4.1f} {W:5d} {tC:7.0f}  {fills[0]:8.1f} {c_lru*W:8.1f}  {win2:8.1f} {c_win*W:8.1f}"
          f"   {fills[0]/W:6.3f}  {c_lru:6.4f}")

# --- E13: la escalera LRU: c_k = -sum_j C(k+1,j)(-1)^j j^{1/a}  (diferencias finitas) ---
print("\nE13 la escalera LRU (saber a profundidad k): c_k(a) = (-1)^k Δ^{k+1}[j^{1/a}](0)")
alpha = 1.5; fills, p, tC, W = lru400
for k in (1, 2, 3, 4):
    ck = -sum(math.comb(k+1, j) * (-1)**j * j**(1/alpha) for j in range(1, k+2))
    print(f"    k={k}: medido={fills[k-1]/W:.4f}  predicho={ck:.4f}")

# --- E11: precisión de Che por tipo ---
print("\nE11 Che por tipo (a=1.5, W=400): acierto_i = 1-exp(-p_i tC)")
rng = np.random.default_rng(99); cum = np.cumsum(p)
total, warm = int(40*tC), int(8*tC)
reqs = np.searchsorted(cum, rng.random(total))
cache = OrderedDict(); hits = np.zeros(len(p)); cnts = np.zeros(len(p))
for nstep, x in enumerate(reqs):
    xi = int(x)
    if xi in cache:
        cache[xi] += 1; cache.move_to_end(xi)
        if nstep >= warm: hits[xi] += 1
    else:
        cache[xi] = 0
        if len(cache) > W: cache.popitem(last=False)
    if nstep >= warm: cnts[xi] += 1
mask = cnts[:2000] > 50
emp = hits[:2000][mask]/cnts[:2000][mask]; teo = (1-np.exp(-p[:2000]*tC))[mask]
r2 = 1 - np.sum((emp-teo)**2)/np.sum((emp-emp.mean())**2)
print(f"    R2 = {r2:.4f}   error medio abs = {np.mean(np.abs(emp-teo)):.4f}")

# --- E12: FIFO — otra política, otra constante ---
print("\nE12 FIFO (a=1.5, W=400): ocupación p T/(1+pT); saber = [pT-(1-e^{-pT})]/(1+pT)")
alpha = 1.5
p, Z = zipf_universe(alpha, 10**5)
Tf = t_char(lambda t: np.sum(p*t/(1+p*t)), 400)
K2f_pred = np.sum((p*Tf - (1-np.exp(-p*Tf)))/(1+p*Tf))
num = quad(lambda v: v**(-1-1/alpha)*(v-1+math.exp(-v))/(1+v), 0, 200, limit=300)[0]
den = quad(lambda v: v**(-1-1/alpha)*v/(1+v), 0, 200, limit=300)[0]
rng = np.random.default_rng(7); cum = np.cumsum(p)
total, warm = int(30*Tf), int(8*Tf)
reqs = np.searchsorted(cum, rng.random(total))
S = set(); qd = deque(); hitc = {}; fills = []
for nstep, x in enumerate(reqs):
    xi = int(x)
    if xi in S: hitc[xi] = hitc.get(xi, 0) + 1
    else:
        S.add(xi); qd.append(xi); hitc[xi] = 0
        if len(qd) > 400:
            old = qd.popleft(); S.discard(old); hitc.pop(old, None)
    if nstep >= warm and nstep % max(1, int(Tf/4)) == 0:
        fills.append(sum(1 for kk in S if hitc.get(kk, 0) >= 1))
print(f"    saber medido={np.mean(fills):.1f}  predicho suma exacta={K2f_pred:.1f}"
      f"  constante continua c_FIFO={num/den:.4f}")
print(f"    jerarquía de políticas en a=1.5:  LRU {2-2**(1/1.5):.4f} > ventana {1-1/1.5:.4f} > FIFO {num/den:.4f}")
print(); print(SEP)
print("Toda cifra 'predicho' proviene de una fórmula derivada en la_orilla.md;")
print("toda cifra 'medido' proviene de simulación o suma exacta independiente.")

D.3 — la_tormenta_experimentos.py

El laboratorio de LA TORMENTA (cap. 29): solver pseudo-espectral 2D/3D con validaciones exactas (bloques V), decaimiento y forzada-disipada 2D (bloques T1–T2), Taylor–Green 3D (T3) y el modelo de conchas Sabra (T4).

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
LA TORMENTA — los experimentos.

Navier–Stokes vivo en la máquina: validación contra soluciones exactas,
el lado resuelto (2D) y el villano abierto (3D) del problema del milenio,
la cascada de Kraichnan y la intermitencia del modelo de conchas.

Bloques (ejecutar por separado; tiempos de pared aproximados en esta máquina):
    python3 la_tormenta_experimentos.py A   # validación: Cole-Hopf, Taylor-Green,
                                            # Noether no viscoso (~2 min)
    python3 la_tormenta_experimentos.py B   # 2D: máximo/BKM + cascada forzada (~9 min)
    python3 la_tormenta_experimentos.py C   # 3D Taylor-Green: el villano (~1 min)
    python3 la_tormenta_experimentos.py D   # Sabra: intermitencia y latido (~1 min)

Las semillas están fijadas: la salida reproduce la_tormenta_resultados.txt.
Requisitos: numpy.
"""
import sys, time
import numpy as np
from numpy.fft import fft, ifft, fft2, ifft2, rfft2, irfft2, fftfreq, rfftfreq, rfftn, irfftn

L = 2*np.pi
bloque = sys.argv[1].upper() if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "A"

# ============================ BLOQUE A: VALIDACIÓN ============================
def bloque_A():
    # --- V1: Burgers vs Cole-Hopf ---
    N = 512; x = np.arange(N)*L/N; k = fftfreq(N, 1.0/N)
    nu = 0.05; u0 = np.sin(x)
    def cole_hopf(t, nu):
        phi0 = np.exp(-(1-np.cos(x))/(2*nu))
        ph = fft(phi0)*np.exp(-nu*k**2*t)
        return -2*nu*np.real(ifft(1j*k*ph))/np.real(ifft(ph))
    mask = np.abs(k) < N/3
    def rhs_b(uh): return -0.5j*k*fft(np.real(ifft(uh))**2)*mask
    def run_b(T, nu, dt):
        uh = fft(u0); E = np.exp(-nu*k**2*dt); Eh = np.exp(-nu*k**2*dt/2); t = 0.0
        while t < T-1e-12:
            a = rhs_b(uh); b = rhs_b(Eh*(uh+dt/2*a)); c = rhs_b(Eh*uh+dt/2*b); d = rhs_b(E*uh+dt*Eh*c)
            uh = E*uh + dt/6*(E*a+2*Eh*(b+c)+d); t += dt
        return uh
    for T in (0.5, 1.0, 2.0):
        err = np.max(np.abs(np.real(ifft(run_b(T, nu, 1e-3))) - cole_hopf(T, nu)))
        print(f"V1 Burgers nu=0.05 t={T}: error_max vs Cole-Hopf = {err:.2e}")
    uh2 = run_b(1.5, 0.005, 2e-4)
    Ek = np.abs(uh2[:N//2])**2; kk = np.arange(1, N//2)
    sel = (kk>=6)&(kk<=60)
    print(f"V1b espectro del choque: pendiente = {np.polyfit(np.log(kk[sel]), np.log(Ek[1:][sel]), 1)[0]:.3f} (predicha -2)")

    # --- V2/V3: Taylor-Green 2D y Noether ---
    M = 128; xx = np.arange(M)*L/M
    X, Y = np.meshgrid(xx, xx, indexing='ij')
    kx = fftfreq(M, 1.0/M); KX, KY = np.meshgrid(kx, kx, indexing='ij')
    K2 = KX**2+KY**2; K2i = np.where(K2==0, 1, K2)
    mask2 = ((np.abs(KX)<M/3)&(np.abs(KY)<M/3)).astype(float)
    def rhs2(wh):
        ps = -wh/K2i; ps[0,0] = 0
        u = np.real(ifft2(1j*KY*ps)); v = np.real(ifft2(-1j*KX*ps))
        wx = np.real(ifft2(1j*KX*wh)); wy = np.real(ifft2(1j*KY*wh))
        return -fft2(u*wx+v*wy)*mask2
    def paso2(wh, dt, nu):
        E = np.exp(-nu*K2*dt); Eh = np.exp(-nu*K2*dt/2)
        a = rhs2(wh); b = rhs2(Eh*(wh+dt/2*a)); c = rhs2(Eh*wh+dt/2*b); d = rhs2(E*wh+dt*Eh*c)
        return E*wh + dt/6*(E*a+2*Eh*(b+c)+d)
    nu2 = 0.02; w0 = -2*np.cos(X)*np.cos(Y)
    wh = fft2(w0); t = 0.0
    while t < 3.0-1e-12: wh = paso2(wh, 5e-3, nu2); t += 5e-3
    w = np.real(ifft2(wh)); wex = w0*np.exp(-2*nu2*t)
    print(f"V2 Taylor-Green 2D t=3: error_max = {np.max(np.abs(w-wex)):.2e}")
    rate = -np.log(np.mean(w**2)/np.mean(w0**2))/(2*t)
    print(f"V2b tasa de decaimiento: medida = {rate:.6f}  predicha 2*nu = {2*nu2:.6f}")
    rng = np.random.default_rng(4)
    wh = fft2(rng.standard_normal((M,M)))*((K2>=2)&(K2<=20)).astype(float)*mask2
    w = np.real(ifft2(wh)); wh = fft2(w/np.std(w))
    def energia(wh):
        ps = -wh/K2i; ps[0,0] = 0
        u = np.real(ifft2(1j*KY*ps)); v = np.real(ifft2(-1j*KX*ps))
        return 0.5*np.mean(u*u+v*v)
    E0 = energia(wh); Z0 = 0.5*np.mean(np.real(ifft2(wh))**2)
    for _ in range(1000): wh = paso2(wh, 2e-3, 0.0)
    E1 = energia(wh); Z1 = 0.5*np.mean(np.real(ifft2(wh))**2)
    print(f"V3 Euler 2D (nu=0) 1000 pasos: |dE/E| = {abs(E1-E0)/E0:.2e}  |dZ/Z| = {abs(Z1-Z0)/Z0:.2e}")

# ============ Infraestructura 2D (256^2, rfft) para bloques B ============
def infra2d(M=256):
    kx = fftfreq(M, 1.0/M); ky = rfftfreq(M, 1.0/M)
    KX, KY = np.meshgrid(kx, ky, indexing='ij')
    K2 = KX**2+KY**2; K2i = np.where(K2==0, 1, K2)
    mask = ((np.abs(KX)<M/3)&(np.abs(KY)<M/3)).astype(float)
    def rhs(wh):
        ps = -wh/K2i; ps[0,0] = 0
        u = irfft2(1j*KY*ps); v = irfft2(-1j*KX*ps)
        wx = irfft2(1j*KX*wh); wy = irfft2(1j*KY*wh)
        return -rfft2(u*wx+v*wy)*mask
    return KX, KY, K2, K2i, mask, rhs

def bloque_B():
    M = 256
    KX, KY, K2, K2i, mask, rhs = infra2d(M)
    Kmag = np.sqrt(K2)
    # --- T1: decaimiento, principio del máximo y BKM ---
    rng = np.random.default_rng(11)
    wh = rfft2(rng.standard_normal((M,M)))*((K2>=4)&(K2<=36)).astype(float)*mask
    w = irfft2(wh); wh = rfft2(w/np.std(w)*3.0)
    nu = 2e-3; dt = 1e-3
    lam = nu*K2; E = np.exp(-lam*dt); Eh = np.exp(-lam*dt/2)
    winf = [np.max(np.abs(irfft2(wh)))]; bkm = 0.0
    for n in range(4000):
        a = rhs(wh); b = rhs(Eh*(wh+dt/2*a)); c = rhs(Eh*wh+dt/2*b); d = rhs(E*wh+dt*Eh*c)
        wh = E*wh + dt/6*(E*a+2*Eh*(b+c)+d)
        if (n+1) % 200 == 0: winf.append(np.max(np.abs(irfft2(wh))))
        bkm += dt*np.max(np.abs(irfft2(wh)))
    winf = np.array(winf)
    print(f"T1 ||w||inf: {winf[0]:.3f} -> {winf[-1]:.3f}  monotona={bool(np.all(np.diff(winf)<=1e-9))}  BKM={bkm:.2f} (finita)")
    # --- T2c: cascada de enstrofía forzada ---
    rng = np.random.default_rng(21)
    wh = rfft2(rng.standard_normal((M,M)))*((K2>=9)&(K2<=49)).astype(float)*mask*0.05
    kf = 6.0
    fh = rfft2(np.random.default_rng(21).standard_normal((M,M)))*((Kmag>kf-0.5)&(Kmag<kf+0.5)).astype(float)*mask
    fh *= 8.0/np.sqrt(np.mean(irfft2(fh)**2))
    nu = 3e-5; alpha = 0.08; dt = 1e-3; nsteps = 22000
    lam = nu*K2+alpha; E = np.exp(-lam*dt); Eh = np.exp(-lam*dt/2)
    spec_acc = None; nacc = 0; t0 = time.time()
    for n in range(nsteps):
        a = rhs(wh)+fh; b = rhs(Eh*(wh+dt/2*a))+fh; c = rhs(Eh*wh+dt/2*b)+fh; d = rhs(E*wh+dt*Eh*c)+fh
        wh = E*wh + dt/6*(E*a+2*Eh*(b+c)+d)
        if n > 2*nsteps//3 and n % 100 == 0:
            Z2 = np.abs(wh)**2/M**4; Z2[:,1:-1] *= 2
            spec = np.bincount(np.rint(Kmag).astype(int).ravel(), weights=Z2.ravel(), minlength=M)
            spec_acc = spec if spec_acc is None else spec_acc+spec; nacc += 1
    specZ = spec_acc/nacc
    kk = np.arange(len(specZ)); Ek = np.where(kk>0, specZ/np.maximum(kk,1)**2, 0)
    sel = (kk>=10)&(kk<=55)
    pend = np.polyfit(np.log(kk[sel]), np.log(Ek[sel]+1e-300), 1)[0]
    print(f"T2c ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s): pendiente E(k) rango enstrofia [10,55] = {pend:.2f} (Kraichnan -3+log)")
    print(f"    ||w||inf = {np.max(np.abs(irfft2(wh))):.1f}")

def bloque_C():
    # --- T3: Taylor-Green 3D 48^3: el villano ---
    N3 = 48; ejes = (0,1,2)
    kx3 = fftfreq(N3, 1.0/N3); kz3 = rfftfreq(N3, 1.0/N3)
    KX3, KY3, KZ3 = np.meshgrid(kx3, kx3, kz3, indexing='ij')
    K23 = KX3**2+KY3**2+KZ3**2; K23i = np.where(K23==0, 1, K23)
    mask3 = ((np.abs(KX3)<N3/3)&(np.abs(KY3)<N3/3)&(np.abs(KZ3)<N3/3)).astype(float)
    xx = np.arange(N3)*L/N3
    X, Y, Z = np.meshgrid(xx, xx, xx, indexing='ij')
    u0 = np.sin(X)*np.cos(Y)*np.cos(Z); v0 = -np.cos(X)*np.sin(Y)*np.cos(Z); w0 = np.zeros_like(u0)
    inv = lambda ah: irfftn(ah, s=(N3,N3,N3), axes=ejes)
    def proj(ah, bh, ch):
        div = (KX3*ah+KY3*bh+KZ3*ch)/K23i
        return ah-KX3*div, bh-KY3*div, ch-KZ3*div
    def rhs3(uh, vh, wh_):
        u = inv(uh); v = inv(vh); w = inv(wh_)
        ox = inv(1j*(KY3*wh_-KZ3*vh)); oy = inv(1j*(KZ3*uh-KX3*wh_)); oz = inv(1j*(KX3*vh-KY3*uh))
        return proj(rfftn(v*oz-w*oy, axes=ejes)*mask3, rfftn(w*ox-u*oz, axes=ejes)*mask3, rfftn(u*oy-v*ox, axes=ejes)*mask3)
    def diag(uh, vh, wh_):
        u = inv(uh); v = inv(vh); w = inv(wh_)
        ox = inv(1j*(KY3*wh_-KZ3*vh)); oy = inv(1j*(KZ3*uh-KX3*wh_)); oz = inv(1j*(KX3*vh-KY3*uh))
        En = 0.5*np.mean(u*u+v*v+w*w); Zn = 0.5*np.mean(ox*ox+oy*oy+oz*oz)
        dux, duy, duz = inv(1j*KX3*uh), inv(1j*KY3*uh), inv(1j*KZ3*uh)
        dvx, dvy, dvz = inv(1j*KX3*vh), inv(1j*KY3*vh), inv(1j*KZ3*vh)
        dwx, dwy, dwz = inv(1j*KX3*wh_), inv(1j*KY3*wh_), inv(1j*KZ3*wh_)
        P = np.mean(ox*ox*dux + oy*oy*dvy + oz*oz*dwz + ox*oy*(duy+dvx) + ox*oz*(duz+dwx) + oy*oz*(dvz+dwy))
        return En, Zn, P
    uh = rfftn(u0, axes=ejes)*mask3; vh = rfftn(v0, axes=ejes)*mask3; wh3 = rfftn(w0, axes=ejes)*mask3
    uh, vh, wh3 = proj(uh, vh, wh3)
    nu3 = 0.008; dt3 = 0.01
    E3 = np.exp(-nu3*K23*dt3); Eh3 = np.exp(-nu3*K23*dt3/2)
    hist = []; t = 0.0; t0 = time.time()
    E_ini, Z_ini, _ = diag(uh, vh, wh3)
    while t < 6.0-1e-9:
        a = rhs3(uh, vh, wh3)
        b = rhs3(Eh3*(uh+dt3/2*a[0]), Eh3*(vh+dt3/2*a[1]), Eh3*(wh3+dt3/2*a[2]))
        c = rhs3(Eh3*uh+dt3/2*b[0], Eh3*vh+dt3/2*b[1], Eh3*wh3+dt3/2*b[2])
        d = rhs3(E3*uh+dt3*Eh3*c[0], E3*vh+dt3*Eh3*c[1], E3*wh3+dt3*Eh3*c[2])
        uh = E3*uh + dt3/6*(E3*a[0]+2*Eh3*(b[0]+c[0])+d[0])
        vh = E3*vh + dt3/6*(E3*a[1]+2*Eh3*(b[1]+c[1])+d[1])
        wh3 = E3*wh3 + dt3/6*(E3*a[2]+2*Eh3*(b[2]+c[2])+d[2])
        t += dt3
        if round(t/dt3) % 25 == 0: hist.append((t,)+diag(uh, vh, wh3))
    hist = np.array(hist)
    ip = np.argmax(hist[:,2])
    print(f"T3 3D TG 48^3 ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s): Z(0)={Z_ini:.3f} -> pico {hist[ip,2]:.3f} en t={hist[ip,0]:.2f} -> Z(6)={hist[-1,2]:.3f}")
    print(f"    produccion max = {np.max(hist[:,3]):.3f} > 0 | E monotona: {bool(np.all(np.diff(hist[:,1])<0))}")
    dEdt = np.gradient(hist[:,1], hist[:,0])
    print(f"    balance |dE/dt + 2 nu Z| max = {np.max(np.abs(dEdt+2*nu3*hist[:,2])):.2e}")
    # alineamiento con autovectores de S (ponderado por enstrofia local)
    u = inv(uh); v = inv(vh); w = inv(wh3)
    ox = inv(1j*(KY3*wh3-KZ3*vh)); oy = inv(1j*(KZ3*uh-KX3*wh3)); oz = inv(1j*(KX3*vh-KY3*uh))
    dux, duy, duz = inv(1j*KX3*uh), inv(1j*KY3*uh), inv(1j*KZ3*uh)
    dvx, dvy, dvz = inv(1j*KX3*vh), inv(1j*KY3*vh), inv(1j*KZ3*vh)
    dwx, dwy, dwz = inv(1j*KX3*wh3), inv(1j*KY3*wh3), inv(1j*KZ3*wh3)
    sub = (slice(None,None,2),)*3
    S = np.zeros(u[sub].shape+(3,3))
    S[...,0,0]=dux[sub]; S[...,1,1]=dvy[sub]; S[...,2,2]=dwz[sub]
    S[...,0,1]=S[...,1,0]=0.5*(duy+dvx)[sub]; S[...,0,2]=S[...,2,0]=0.5*(duz+dwx)[sub]; S[...,1,2]=S[...,2,1]=0.5*(dvz+dwy)[sub]
    Om = np.stack([ox[sub],oy[sub],oz[sub]],axis=-1)
    nrm = np.linalg.norm(Om,axis=-1,keepdims=True)
    On = (Om/np.maximum(nrm,1e-12)).reshape(-1,3); pesos = (nrm.reshape(-1))**2
    vals, vecs = np.linalg.eigh(S.reshape(-1,3,3))
    wm = lambda i: np.average(np.abs(np.einsum('ij,ij->i', On, vecs[:,:,i])), weights=pesos)
    print(f"    alineamiento |cos(w,e_i)|: compresivo={wm(0):.3f} INTERMEDIO={wm(1):.3f} extensivo={wm(2):.3f}")

def bloque_D():
    # --- T4: Sabra: intermitencia y latido ---
    N = 18; k = 0.0625*2.0**np.arange(N); nu = 3e-7
    f = np.zeros(N, complex); f[1] = 0.005*(1+1j)
    dt = 2e-4; E = np.exp(-nu*k**2*dt)
    kp1 = np.concatenate([k[1:], [0.0]]); km1 = np.concatenate([[0.0], k[:-1]])
    def rhs(u):
        up = np.zeros(N+4, complex); up[2:-2] = u
        u1 = up[3:N+3]; u2 = up[4:N+4]; m1 = up[1:N+1]; m2 = up[0:N]
        return 1j*(kp1*np.conj(u1)*u2 - 0.5*k*np.conj(m1)*u1 + 0.5*km1*m1*m2) + f
    rng = np.random.default_rng(5)
    u = (rng.standard_normal(N)+1j*rng.standard_normal(N))*1e-3*k**(-1/3)
    nsteps = 1_200_000; t0 = time.time()
    S2 = np.zeros(N); S4 = np.zeros(N); S6 = np.zeros(N); ns = 0
    for n in range(nsteps):
        a1 = rhs(u); up = E*u + dt*E*a1; a2 = rhs(up)
        u = E*u + dt/2*(E*a1 + a2)
        if n > nsteps//3 and n % 100 == 0:
            au = np.abs(u); S2 += au*au; S4 += au**4; S6 += au**6; ns += 1
    S2/=ns; S4/=ns; S6/=ns
    ri = np.arange(4,13)
    z2 = -np.polyfit(np.log(k[ri]), np.log(S2[ri]), 1)[0]
    z6 = -np.polyfit(np.log(k[ri]), np.log(S6[ri]), 1)[0]
    F = S4/S2**2
    print(f"T4 Sabra ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s): zeta_2={z2:.3f} zeta_6={z6:.3f} anomalia={z6-3*z2:+.3f} (K41: 0)")
    print(f"    aplanamiento conchas 4,7,10,12: {F[4]:.2f}, {F[7]:.2f}, {F[10]:.2f}, {F[12]:.2f} (K41: constante)")
    comp = np.log(S2[ri]) + z2*np.log(k[ri]); res = comp-comp.mean()
    print(f"    latido (residuo log-periodico): amplitud pico-a-pico = {res.max()-res.min():.3f} nats")

{"A": bloque_A, "B": bloque_B, "C": bloque_C, "D": bloque_D}[bloque]()

D.4 — el_rayo_experimentos.py

Las verificaciones exhaustivas de EL RAYO (cap. 30): Lindenbaum/Stone/Galois, Ramsey por enumeración, percolación, DLA, Borel, JL, Watson, E8, Ising.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
EL RAYO — los experimentos.

Cartas locales del meta-universo matemático y la dinámica de sus sinapsis.
Cada experimento imprime PREDICHO (teorema citado o derivado en el_rayo.md)
vs MEDIDO (la máquina). Semillas fijas: la salida reproduce
el_rayo_resultados.txt.

  LA GEOGRAFÍA — E1 álgebra de Lindenbaum + conexión de Galois Mod⊣Th (exhaustivo).
  EL RAYO      — E2 Ramsey R(3,3)=6 demostrado por enumeración total + Goodman;
                 E3 percolación ER (el amanecer de la conectividad);
                 E4 DLA (la raíz laplaciana del rayo, dimensión fractal);
                 E9 ramificación crítica (ley de Borel exacta + cola -1/2).
  EL SALTO     — E5 Johnson–Lindenstrauss + casi-ortogonalidad en dimensión alta;
                 E6 Pólya (la dimensión decide el destino; Watson + caminantes);
                 E7 E8: los 240 vectores mínimos contados, densidad pi^4/384.
  LA LECTURA   — E8 Ising 2D vs Onsager exacto (la caligrafía crítica del universo).

Requisitos: numpy, scipy. Tiempo total ~4-6 min.
"""
import numpy as np, math, time
from itertools import combinations, product
from math import pi

SEP = "-"*78

# ========================= LA GEOGRAFÍA =========================
print(SEP); print("LA GEOGRAFÍA — el campo, en carta local")
def Mod(T):
    m = 0b11111111
    for s in T: m &= s
    return m
def Th(M):
    return frozenset(s for s in range(256) if (s & M) == M)
ok_cierre = all(Mod(Th(M)) == M for M in range(256))
rng = np.random.default_rng(8); ok_idem = True
for _ in range(500):
    T = set(int(x) for x in rng.integers(0, 256, size=rng.integers(1, 6)))
    if Th(Mod(Th(Mod(set(Th(Mod(T))))))) != Th(Mod(T)): ok_idem = False
print(f"E1 Lindenbaum n=3: oraciones/equiv=256 | teorias cerradas={len({Th(M) for M in range(256)})}"
      f" | puntos de Stone={sum(1 for M in range(256) if bin(M).count('1')==1)}")
print(f"E1 Galois Mod-Th: cierre 256/256={ok_cierre} | idempotencia={ok_idem}")

# ========================= EL RAYO =========================
print(); print(SEP); print("EL RAYO — la dinámica de las sinapsis")
# --- E2: Ramsey ---
edges6 = list(combinations(range(6),2)); eidx = {e:i for i,e in enumerate(edges6)}
tri_masks = [ (1<<eidx[(a,b)])|(1<<eidx[(a,c)])|(1<<eidx[(b,c)]) for a,b,c in combinations(range(6),3) ]
min_mono, sin_mono = 99, 0
for col in range(1<<15):
    mono = sum(1 for tm in tri_masks if (col & tm)==0 or (col & tm)==tm)
    if mono==0: sin_mono += 1
    if mono<min_mono: min_mono = mono
rojo = {tuple(sorted((i,(i+1)%5))) for i in range(5)}
mono5 = 0
for a,b,c in combinations(range(5),3):
    cols = [tuple(sorted(e)) in rojo for e in ((a,b),(a,c),(b,c))]
    if all(cols) or not any(cols): mono5 += 1
print(f"E2 K6: 32768 coloraciones | sin triangulo mono = {sin_mono} | minimo mono = {min_mono} (Goodman: 2)")
print(f"E2 K5 pentagono/pentagrama: {mono5} monocromos => R(3,3)=6 DEMOSTRADO | frontera humana: 43<=R(5,5)<=46")

# --- E3: percolación ---
def gigante(n, c, seed):
    r = np.random.default_rng(seed); m = int(c*n/2)
    padre = np.arange(n)
    def find(x):
        while padre[x]!=x: padre[x]=padre[padre[x]]; x=padre[x]
        return x
    a = r.integers(0,n,m); b = r.integers(0,n,m)
    for i in range(m):
        ra, rb = find(a[i]), find(b[i])
        if ra!=rb: padre[ra]=rb
    from collections import Counter
    return max(Counter(find(i) for i in range(n)).values())/n
def s_teo(c):
    if c<=1: return 0.0
    s=0.5
    for _ in range(200): s = 1-math.exp(-c*s)
    return s
print("E3 percolacion ER n=200000 (c: medida / teoria):", end=" ")
for c in (0.9, 1.2, 1.5, 2.0):
    print(f"c={c}: {gigante(200_000,c,int(c*100)):.4f}/{s_teo(c):.4f}", end="  ")
print()

# --- E4: DLA ---
t0=time.time(); G=1400; C=G//2
grid = np.zeros((G,G), dtype=bool); grid[C,C]=True
Rmax=1.0; rng = np.random.default_rng(42); NP_T=40000; npart=1; NB=4096
def nacer(n, R):
    th = rng.random(n)*2*np.pi
    return (C+(R+5)*np.cos(th)).astype(np.int32), (C+(R+5)*np.sin(th)).astype(np.int32)
wx, wy = nacer(NB, Rmax)
while npart < NP_T:
    mv = rng.integers(0,4,size=NB)
    wx += np.where(mv==0,1,0)-np.where(mv==1,1,0); wy += np.where(mv==2,1,0)-np.where(mv==3,1,0)
    lejos = (wx-C)**2+(wy-C)**2 > (3*Rmax+30)**2
    if lejos.any():
        nx, ny = nacer(int(lejos.sum()), Rmax); wx[lejos]=nx; wy[lejos]=ny
    adj = grid[wx+1,wy]|grid[wx-1,wy]|grid[wx,wy+1]|grid[wx,wy-1]
    if adj.any():
        for x,y in zip(wx[adj], wy[adj]):
            if not grid[x,y]:
                grid[x,y]=True; npart+=1
                r2 = (x-C)**2+(y-C)**2
                if r2 > Rmax*Rmax: Rmax = math.sqrt(r2)
        nx, ny = nacer(int(adj.sum()), Rmax); wx[adj]=nx; wy[adj]=ny
xs_, ys_ = np.where(grid); dd = np.sqrt((xs_-C)**2+(ys_-C)**2)
rs = np.exp(np.linspace(np.log(12), np.log(Rmax*0.55), 10))
D = np.polyfit(np.log(rs), np.log([ (dd<=r).sum() for r in rs ]), 1)[0]
print(f"E4 DLA {npart} particulas ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s): dimension fractal D = {D:.3f} (canonico ~1.71; espacio pleno: 2)")

# --- E9: ramificación crítica ---
rng = np.random.default_rng(99)
TOT, CHUNK, MAXS, BLK = 300_000, 25_000, 100_000, 1000
Nf_all=[]; cens=0
for ch in range(TOT//CHUNK):
    restante = np.ones(CHUNK, dtype=np.int64); N = np.zeros(CHUNK, dtype=np.int64)
    vivo = np.ones(CHUNK, dtype=bool)
    for blk in range(MAXS//BLK):
        idx = np.where(vivo)[0]
        if len(idx)==0: break
        inc = rng.poisson(1.0, size=(len(idx), BLK)).astype(np.int32)-1
        cs = np.cumsum(inc, axis=1, dtype=np.int32)
        alcanza = (restante[idx][:,None].astype(np.int32)+cs)==0
        primero = np.where(alcanza.any(axis=1), alcanza.argmax(axis=1), -1)
        hit = primero>=0
        N[idx[hit]] += primero[hit]+1; vivo[idx[hit]] = False
        N[idx[~hit]] += BLK; restante[idx[~hit]] += cs[~hit,-1]
        del inc, cs, alcanza
    Nf_all.append(N[~vivo]); cens += int(vivo.sum())
Nf = np.concatenate(Nf_all)
print(f"E9 GW critico Poisson(1): {len(Nf)}/{TOT} arboles ({cens} censurados)")
for n in (1,3,5):
    print(f"    P(N={n}): medido={np.mean(Nf==n):.5f} Borel={math.exp(-n)*n**(n-1)/math.factorial(n):.5f}", end=" |")
ns = np.array([10,30,100,300,1000,3000])
tail = np.array([(Nf>=n).mean() for n in ns])
print(f"\n    pendiente de cola = {np.polyfit(np.log(ns), np.log(tail), 1)[0]:.3f} (teoria -1/2)")

# ========================= EL SALTO =========================
print(); print(SEP); print("EL SALTO — entre abstracciones multidimensionales")
from scipy.spatial.distance import pdist
rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
n, d = 400, 800
X = rng.standard_normal((n,d)); D0 = pdist(X)
print("E5 Johnson-Lindenstrauss R^800 -> R^k (distorsion max / cota):", end=" ")
for k in (50, 100, 200, 400):
    R = rng.standard_normal((d,k))/np.sqrt(k)
    print(f"k={k}: {np.max(np.abs(pdist(X@R)/D0-1)):.3f}/{math.sqrt(8*math.log(n)/k):.3f}", end="  ")
print()
for d2 in (100, 1000, 10000):
    V = rng.standard_normal((2000, d2)); V /= np.linalg.norm(V, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    cosv = np.abs(np.sum(V[::2]*V[1::2], axis=1))
    print(f"E5b d={d2}: |cos| medio = {cosv.mean():.4f} (teoria sqrt(2/pi d) = {math.sqrt(2/(math.pi*d2)):.4f})")

# --- E6: Pólya ---
Ng = 160; th = (np.arange(Ng)+0.5)*2*np.pi/Ng; CX = np.cos(th)
S = 0.0
for i in range(Ng):
    S += np.sum(1.0/(1.0-((CX[i]+CX[:,None])+CX[None,:])/3.0))
u3 = S/Ng**3; p3 = 1-1/u3
print(f"E6 Watson (malla 160^3): u3={u3:.5f} => P(retorno d=3) = {p3:.5f} (clasico 0.34054)")
def retorno(d, nw, T, seed):
    r = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    pos = np.zeros((nw,d), dtype=np.int32); volvio = np.zeros(nw, dtype=bool)
    for b in range(T//2000):
        eje = r.integers(0,d,size=(nw,2000)); sig = r.choice(np.array([-1,1],dtype=np.int32),size=(nw,2000))
        for t in range(2000):
            pos[np.arange(nw), eje[:,t]] += sig[:,t]
            volvio |= ~pos.any(axis=1)
    return volvio.mean()
for d in (1,2,3):
    print(f"E6b d={d}: retorno en 4e4 pasos = {retorno(d,6000,40_000,d*11):.4f}"
          + ("  (recurrente ->1)" if d<3 else f"  (transitorio; teoria {p3:.4f})"))

# --- E7: E8 ---
mins = set()
for i,j in combinations(range(8),2):
    for si in (1,-1):
        for sj in (1,-1):
            v = [0]*8; v[i]=si; v[j]=sj
            if sum(v)%2==0: mins.add(tuple(v))
for signs in product([1,-1], repeat=8):
    if signs.count(-1)%2==0: mins.add(tuple(s*0.5 for s in signs))
print(f"E7 E8: vectores minimos = {len(mins)} (240) | normas^2 = {({sum(x*x for x in v) for v in mins})}"
      f" | densidad pi^4/384 = {pi**4/384:.5f} (optima: Viazovska) | Leech d=24: 196560 [T]")

# ========================= LA LECTURA =========================
print(); print(SEP); print("LA LECTURA — la caligrafía crítica del universo")
Lb = 64; mask_a = (np.add.outer(np.arange(Lb), np.arange(Lb))%2==0)
def sweep(s, beta):
    for m in (mask_a, ~mask_a):
        nb = np.roll(s,1,0)+np.roll(s,-1,0)+np.roll(s,1,1)+np.roll(s,-1,1)
        acc = (np.random.random((Lb,Lb)) < np.exp(-beta*np.clip(2*s*nb,0,None))) & m
        s = np.where(acc, -s, s)
    return s
Tc = 2/math.log(1+math.sqrt(2))
m_ons = lambda T: 0.0 if T>=Tc else (1-math.sinh(2/T)**(-4))**0.125
np.random.seed(11)
print(f"E8 Ising 64^2, arranque ordenado. Tc exacta = {Tc:.4f}")
for T in (1.8, 2.0, 2.1, 2.2, 2.4):
    s2 = np.ones((Lb,Lb), dtype=np.int8); beta = 1.0/T
    for _ in range(500): s2 = sweep(s2, beta)
    ms = []
    for _ in range(800):
        s2 = sweep(s2, beta); ms.append(abs(s2.mean()))
    print(f"    T={T}: |m| medida = {np.mean(ms):.4f}  Onsager exacta = {m_ons(T):.4f}")
print(); print(SEP)
print("Toda cifra 'teoria/exacta' es un teorema citado o derivado en el_rayo.md;")
print("toda cifra 'medida' salio de esta maquina. Semillas fijas.")

D.5 — la_catedral_experimentos.py

El censo de LA CATEDRAL (cap. 31): parser de set.mm, grafo de 1,5 M de aristas, clausuras transitivas por bitsets, kernel de adhesión, nulos Monte Carlo. Guarda los intermedios /tmp/cat_* que reutilizan la telaraña y el sexto.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
LA CATEDRAL — los experimentos sobre el grafo real de la matemática formalizada.

Corpus: metamath/set.mm (~50 MB, ~47.000 teoremas verificados por máquina,
cada demostración con sus referencias explícitas). Obtención:

    git clone --depth 1 --filter=blob:none https://github.com/metamath/set.mm.git metamath

Fases (ejecutar en orden; semillas fijas; salida = la_catedral_resultados.txt):

    python3 la_catedral_experimentos.py parse    # construir el DAG (~1 min)
    python3 la_catedral_experimentos.py censo    # M1-M6: Zipf, Heaps, océano,
                                                 # profundidad, kernel (~1 min)
    python3 la_catedral_experimentos.py conos    # M4: clausuras transitivas exactas
    python3 la_catedral_experimentos.py nulos    # M7: NULL-U / NULL-P / NULL-R
    python3 la_catedral_experimentos.py mezcla   # D1-D2: descomposición y mixtos

Requisitos: numpy. Los intermedios van a /tmp/cat_*.npy.
"""
import sys, re, time, math
import numpy as np
from collections import defaultdict

N_ESPERADO = 50435
fase = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "censo"

def cargar():
    src = np.load("/tmp/cat_src.npy"); dst = np.load("/tmp/cat_dst.npy")
    labels = [l.split("\t")[0] for l in open("/tmp/cat_labels.txt")]
    tipos = [l.strip().split("\t")[1] for l in open("/tmp/cat_labels.txt")]
    return src, dst, labels, tipos

# ============================ PARSE ============================
if fase == "parse":
    t0 = time.time()
    txt = open("metamath/set.mm", encoding="utf-8").read()
    txt = re.sub(r"\$\(.*?\$\)", " ", txt, flags=re.DOTALL)
    toks = txt.split()
    orden = {}; tipo = {}; deps_raw = []; secuencia = []
    i = 0; n = len(toks)
    while i < n:
        t = toks[i]
        if t in ("$a", "$p", "$f", "$e") and i > 0:
            lab = toks[i-1]
            if t == "$a":
                orden[lab] = len(secuencia); tipo[lab] = 'a'; secuencia.append(lab)
                while i < n and toks[i] != "$.": i += 1
            elif t == "$p":
                j = i
                while j < n and toks[j] != "$=": j += 1
                refs = []
                if j < n:
                    k = j+1
                    if toks[k] == "(":
                        k += 1
                        while toks[k] != ")": refs.append(toks[k]); k += 1
                        while k < n and toks[k] != "$.": k += 1
                    else:
                        while toks[k] != "$.":
                            if toks[k] != "?": refs.append(toks[k])
                            k += 1
                    i = k
                orden[lab] = len(secuencia); tipo[lab] = 'p'; secuencia.append(lab)
                deps_raw.append((lab, refs))
            else:
                while i < n and toks[i] != "$.": i += 1
        i += 1
    src, dst = [], []
    for lab, refs in deps_raw:
        o = orden[lab]; vistos = set()
        for r in refs:
            if r in orden and r not in vistos:
                vistos.add(r); src.append(o); dst.append(orden[r])
    np.save("/tmp/cat_src.npy", np.array(src, dtype=np.int32))
    np.save("/tmp/cat_dst.npy", np.array(dst, dtype=np.int32))
    with open("/tmp/cat_labels.txt", "w") as f:
        for l in secuencia: f.write(f"{l}\t{tipo[l]}\n")
    print(f"CATEDRAL: {len(secuencia)} piedras "
          f"({sum(1 for l in secuencia if tipo[l]=='a')} axiomas/def, {len(deps_raw)} teoremas), "
          f"{len(src)/1e6:.2f}M aristas ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s)")

# ============================ CENSO ============================
elif fase == "censo":
    src, dst, labels, tipos = cargar()
    N = len(labels); M = len(src)
    es_teo = np.array([t == 'p' for t in tipos])
    indeg = np.bincount(dst, minlength=N)
    usados = indeg[indeg > 0]
    rangos = np.sort(usados)[::-1]
    rr = np.arange(10, 3000)
    zipf = np.polyfit(np.log(rr), np.log(rangos[rr-1]), 1)[0]
    for kmin in (5, 20, 50):
        cola = usados[usados >= kmin].astype(float)
        print(f"M1 kmin={kmin}: alpha_MLE={1+len(cola)/np.sum(np.log(cola/(kmin-0.5))):.3f}")
    print(f"M1 pendiente Zipf = {zipf:.3f}")
    top = np.argsort(indeg)[::-1][:8]
    print("M1 pilares:", ", ".join(f"{labels[i]}({indeg[i]})" for i in top))
    # Heaps
    ot = np.argsort(src, kind='stable'); s_s = src[ot]; d_s = dst[ot]
    visto = np.zeros(N, dtype=bool); V = 0; cT = []; cV = []; n_teo = 0; ult = -1
    vT = []; vV = []
    for e in range(M):
        if s_s[e] != ult:
            if ult >= 0:
                n_teo += 1
                if n_teo % 100 == 0: cT.append(n_teo); cV.append(V)
            ult = s_s[e]
        if not visto[d_s[e]]: visto[d_s[e]] = True; V += 1
        if (e+1) % 2000 == 0: vT.append(e+1); vV.append(V)
    cT = np.array(cT); cV = np.array(cV); vT = np.array(vT); vV = np.array(vV)
    print(f"M2 Heaps vs teoremas = {np.polyfit(np.log(cT[cT>300]), np.log(cV[cT>300]), 1)[0]:.3f}"
          f" | vs tokens = {np.polyfit(np.log(vT[vT>10000]), np.log(vV[vT>10000]), 1)[0]:.3f}"
          f" | Karlin/ORILLA para oceano fijo: {-zipf:.3f}... (=1/alpha con alpha={-1/zipf:.3f})")
    outdeg = np.bincount(src, minlength=N)
    teos = np.where(outdeg > 0)[0]
    medias = [outdeg[d].mean() for d in np.array_split(teos, 10)]
    print(f"M3 citas/dem por decil: {[f'{m:.0f}' for m in medias]} (oceano x{medias[-1]/medias[0]:.1f})")
    # profundidad
    deps = defaultdict(list)
    for e in range(M): deps[int(src[e])].append(int(dst[e]))
    depth = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.int32)
    for i in range(N):
        dl = deps.get(i)
        if dl: depth[i] = 1 + max(depth[d] for d in dl)
    dt = depth[es_teo]
    print(f"M5 profundidad: max={depth.max()} ({labels[int(np.argmax(depth))]}) media={dt.mean():.1f} mediana={np.median(dt):.0f}"
          f" | r(prof,epoca)={np.corrcoef(np.arange(N)[es_teo], dt)[0,1]:.3f}")
    np.save('/tmp/cat_depth.npy', depth)
    # kernel + recencia
    rel = (s_s - d_s)/np.maximum(s_s, 1)
    print(f"M6 recencia: cuartiles de (t-l)/t = {np.quantile(rel, [.25,.5,.75]).round(3)}")
    KMAX = 60000
    cnt = np.zeros(KMAX, np.int64); expo = np.zeros(KMAX); att = np.zeros(KMAX)
    ir = np.zeros(N, np.int32); existe = -1
    for e in range(M):
        s = int(s_s[e]); d = int(d_s[e])
        while existe < s-1:
            existe += 1; cnt[ir[existe]] += 1
        if (e+1) % 20 == 0: expo += cnt
        k = ir[d]; att[k] += 1
        cnt[k] -= 1; cnt[k+1] += 1; ir[d] += 1
    ks = np.arange(1, 2000); Ak = att[ks]/np.maximum(expo[ks], 1)
    sk = att[ks] > 50
    print(f"M6 kernel de grado: gamma = {np.polyfit(np.log(ks[sk]), np.log(Ak[sk]), 1)[0]:.3f} (Price=1, uniforme=0)")

# ============================ CONOS ============================
elif fase == "conos":
    src, dst, labels, tipos = cargar()
    N = len(labels); M = len(src); W = (N+7)//8
    POP = np.array([bin(i).count("1") for i in range(256)], dtype=np.int32)
    deps = defaultdict(list)
    for e in range(M): deps[int(src[e])].append(int(dst[e]))
    cono = np.zeros((N, W), dtype=np.uint8); tam = np.zeros(N, np.int32)
    for i in range(N):
        dl = deps.get(i)
        if dl:
            fila = cono[i]
            for d in dl:
                np.bitwise_or(fila, cono[d], out=fila); fila[d >> 3] |= (1 << (d & 7))
            tam[i] = int(POP[fila].sum())
    print(f"M4 cimientos: cuartiles {np.quantile(tam[tam>0], [.25,.5,.75,.95]).astype(int)} media {tam[tam>0].mean():.0f} max {tam.max()}")
    del cono
    usa = defaultdict(list)
    for e in range(M): usa[int(dst[e])].append(int(src[e]))
    cono2 = np.zeros((N, W), dtype=np.uint8); imp = np.zeros(N, np.int32)
    for i in range(N-1, -1, -1):
        ul = usa.get(i)
        if ul:
            fila = cono2[i]
            for u in ul:
                np.bitwise_or(fila, cono2[u], out=fila); fila[u >> 3] |= (1 << (u & 7))
            imp[i] = int(POP[fila].sum())
    topi = np.argsort(imp)[::-1][:4]
    print("M4 mayor impacto:", ", ".join(f"{labels[i]}({imp[i]})" for i in topi))
    iv = imp[imp > 0].astype(float)
    ss = np.array([10, 30, 100, 300, 1000, 3000, 10000])
    tail = np.array([(iv >= s).mean() for s in ss])
    print(f"M4 cola de impacto: {np.round(tail, 4).tolist()} pendiente={np.polyfit(np.log(ss), np.log(tail), 1)[0]:.3f} (avalancha critica: -0.5)")
    np.save('/tmp/cat_imp.npy', imp)

# ============================ NULOS ============================
elif fase == "nulos":
    src, dst, labels, tipos = cargar()
    N = len(labels); M = len(src)
    ot = np.argsort(src, kind='stable'); s_s = src[ot]; d_s = dst[ot]
    rng = np.random.default_rng(2026)
    grupos = defaultdict(list)
    for e in range(M): grupos[int(s_s[e])].append(e)
    teoremas = sorted(grupos.keys())
    rel_real = (s_s - d_s)/np.maximum(s_s, 1)
    def medir(dn, nombre):
        ind = np.bincount(dn, minlength=N)
        rangos = np.sort(ind[ind > 0])[::-1]; rr = np.arange(10, min(3000, len(rangos)))
        zipf = np.polyfit(np.log(rr), np.log(rangos[rr-1]), 1)[0]
        dp = np.zeros(N, np.int32); deps = defaultdict(list)
        for e in range(M): deps[int(s_s[e])].append(int(dn[e]))
        for i in range(N):
            dl = deps.get(i)
            if dl: dp[i] = 1 + max(dp[d] for d in dl)
        print(f"M7 {nombre}: max_uso={ind.max()} zipf={zipf:.2f} prof_media={dp[dp>0].mean():.0f} prof_max={dp.max()}")
    du = np.empty(M, np.int32)
    for t in teoremas:
        es = grupos[t]; du[es] = rng.integers(0, t, size=len(es))
    medir(du, "NULL-U")
    urna = np.empty(M, np.int32); nu = 0; dp_ = np.empty(M, np.int32)
    for t in teoremas:
        for e in grupos[t]:
            r = rng.integers(0, nu + t)
            tgt = int(urna[r]) if r < nu else int(r - nu)
            dp_[e] = tgt; urna[nu] = tgt; nu += 1
    medir(dp_, "NULL-P")
    dr = np.empty(M, np.int32)
    for t in teoremas:
        es = grupos[t]
        rels = rel_real[rng.integers(0, M, size=len(es))]
        dr[es] = np.clip(((1-rels)*t).astype(np.int64), 0, t-1)
    medir(dr, "NULL-R")
    dpr = np.load('/tmp/cat_depth.npy')
    ind_real = np.bincount(d_s, minlength=N)
    rr = np.arange(10, 3000)
    zr = np.polyfit(np.log(rr), np.log(np.sort(ind_real[ind_real>0])[::-1][rr-1]), 1)[0]
    print(f"M7 REALIDAD: max_uso={ind_real.max()} zipf={zr:.2f} prof_media={dpr[dpr>0].mean():.0f} prof_max={dpr.max()}")

# ============================ MEZCLA ============================
elif fase == "mezcla":
    src, dst, labels, tipos = cargar()
    N = len(labels); M = len(src)
    ot = np.argsort(src, kind='stable'); s_s = src[ot]; d_s = dst[ot]
    indeg = np.bincount(dst, minlength=N)
    hubs = set(np.argsort(indeg)[::-1][:200].tolist())
    es_hub = np.array([int(d) in hubs for d in d_s])
    rel = (s_s - d_s)/np.maximum(s_s, 1)
    q = es_hub.mean()
    print(f"D1 q(citas a pilares)={q:.3f} | rel mediana pilares={np.median(rel[es_hub]):.3f} contenido={np.median(rel[~es_hub]):.3f}")
    gap = (s_s - d_s)[~es_hub]
    print(f"D1 salto absoluto de contenido: cuartiles {np.quantile(gap, [.25,.5,.75]).astype(int)}")
    # kernel solo-contenido
    KMAX = 60000
    cnt = np.zeros(KMAX, np.int64); expo = np.zeros(KMAX); att = np.zeros(KMAX)
    ir = np.zeros(N, np.int32); existe = -1
    for e in range(M):
        s = int(s_s[e]); d = int(d_s[e])
        while existe < s-1:
            existe += 1; cnt[ir[existe]] += 1
        if (e+1) % 20 == 0: expo += cnt
        k = ir[d]
        if not es_hub[e]: att[k] += 1
        cnt[k] -= 1; cnt[k+1] += 1; ir[d] += 1
    ks = np.arange(1, 500); Ak = att[ks]/np.maximum(expo[ks], 1); sk = att[ks] > 50
    print(f"D1 kernel de contenido: gamma = {np.polyfit(np.log(ks[sk]), np.log(Ak[sk]), 1)[0]:.3f}")
    # MIXTO-1: q Price + (1-q) recencia de contenido
    rng = np.random.default_rng(9026)
    grupos = defaultdict(list)
    for e in range(M): grupos[int(s_s[e])].append(e)
    rc = rel[~es_hub]
    urna = np.empty(M, np.int32); nu = 0; dm = np.empty(M, np.int32)
    for t in sorted(grupos.keys()):
        for e in grupos[t]:
            if rng.random() < q:
                r = rng.integers(0, nu + t)
                tgt = int(urna[r]) if r < nu else int(r - nu)
            else:
                rl = rc[rng.integers(0, len(rc))]
                tgt = int(min(t-1, max(0, (1-rl)*t)))
            dm[e] = tgt; urna[nu] = tgt; nu += 1
    ind = np.bincount(dm, minlength=N)
    rangos = np.sort(ind[ind > 0])[::-1]; rr = np.arange(10, 3000)
    zipf_m = np.polyfit(np.log(rr), np.log(rangos[rr-1]), 1)[0]
    dp = np.zeros(N, np.int32); deps = defaultdict(list)
    for e in range(M): deps[int(s_s[e])].append(int(dm[e]))
    for i in range(N):
        dl = deps.get(i)
        if dl: dp[i] = 1 + max(dp[d] for d in dl)
    print(f"D2 MIXTO-1: max_uso={ind.max()} zipf={zipf_m:.2f} prof_media={dp[dp>0].mean():.0f} prof_max={dp.max()}")
    print("D2 VEREDICTO: ningun kernel sin memoria reproduce (pilares, zipf, profundidad) a la vez;")
    print("   la catedral exige estructura modular: tronco preferencial + naves paralelas anchas.")
else:
    print(__doc__)

D.6 — el_bosque_experimentos.py

El motor GÉNESIS de EL BOSQUE (cap. 32): universos silváticos U=⟨G;π_g,π_f,π_n,ν,w⟩, la física Φ, los barridos de 102 universos, la ablación y el tiempo cósmico.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
EL BOSQUE — los experimentos de la silvática.

La ciencia comparada de universos-de-conocimiento crecidos desde la nada.
Un universo es un punto U = <G; pi_g, pi_f, pi_n, nu, w> en el espacio de
diales; su física observable es Phi(U) = (zipf, rho, q, hapax). La realidad
(set.mm, medida en LA CATEDRAL) es Phi* = (-1.10, 1.12, 0.518, 0.338).

Diales de GÉNESIS:
  pi_g  gramática : citar los G enunciados primordiales (uniforme en [0,G))
  pi_f  fama      : urna preferencial (prob ~ grado+1, Price)
  pi_n  naves     : citar uniforme dentro del módulo propio (módulos
                    contiguos; nueva nave con prob nu por enunciado)
  resto uniforme sobre todo el pasado
  w     ensanche  : las citas por enunciado crecen ~ (t/N)^w (océano creciente)

Fases:  python3 el_bosque_experimentos.py bosque1 | bosque2 | ablacion | tiempo
Requisitos: numpy y los intermedios de LA CATEDRAL en /tmp (para congelamiento
real: fase `real`). Salida de referencia: el_bosque_resultados.txt.
"""
import sys, time
import numpy as np
from collections import defaultdict, Counter

fase = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "bosque2"

PHI = np.array([-1.10, 141/126, 0.518, 0.338])
ESC = np.array([0.30, 0.50, 0.15, 0.10])
def dist(ph): return float(np.sqrt(np.mean(((np.array(ph)-PHI)/ESC)**2)))

def genesis(N, pg, pf, pn, nu, w, seed, A=40, G=50, m0=2, mtop=30):
    """Autopoiesis: desde A enunciados primordiales, crecer N con 4 fuerzas."""
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    urna = []; sl = []; dl = []; ini = 0
    for i in range(A, N):
        if rng.random() < nu: ini = i                      # nace una nave
        m = min(mtop, m0 + int((mtop-m0)*(i/N)**w * rng.uniform(0.5, 1.5)))
        vistos = set()
        for _ in range(m):
            r = rng.random()
            if r < pg: tgt = int(rng.integers(0, G))
            elif r < pg+pf and urna: tgt = urna[rng.integers(len(urna))]
            elif r < pg+pf+pn and i-ini > 1: tgt = int(rng.integers(ini, i))
            else: tgt = int(rng.integers(0, i))
            if tgt in vistos: continue
            vistos.add(tgt); sl.append(i); dl.append(tgt); urna.append(tgt)
    return np.array(sl, dtype=np.int32), np.array(dl, dtype=np.int32)

def prof(N, s, d):
    deps = defaultdict(list)
    for e in range(len(s)): deps[int(s[e])].append(int(d[e]))
    dp = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.int32)
    for i in range(N):
        x = deps.get(i)
        if x: dp[i] = 1 + max(dp[j] for j in x)
    return dp[dp > 0].mean() if (dp > 0).any() else 0.0

def medir(N, s, d, sn):
    """Phi = (zipf, rho=prof/prof_nulo_uniforme, q_top200, hapax)."""
    ind = np.bincount(d, minlength=N); u = ind[ind > 0]
    rangos = np.sort(u)[::-1]; rr = np.arange(5, min(1500, len(rangos)-1))
    z = np.polyfit(np.log(rr), np.log(rangos[rr-1]), 1)[0]
    q = np.sort(ind)[::-1][:200].sum()/len(d); p1 = np.mean(u == 1)
    dn = (np.random.default_rng(sn).random(len(s))*s).astype(np.int32)
    return z, prof(N, s, d)/max(prof(N, s, dn), 1e-9), q, p1

def clasificar(z, rho, q, p1):
    if q > 0.75 and rho < 0.6: return "CONDENSADO"
    if rho > 4: return "AGUJA"
    if q < 0.12 and abs(z) < 0.45: return "PRADERA"
    return "MIXTA"

if fase == "real":
    src = np.load("/tmp/cat_src.npy"); dst = np.load("/tmp/cat_dst.npy")
    Nr = 50435; mitad = Nr//2
    th = set(np.argsort(np.bincount(dst[src < mitad], minlength=Nr))[::-1][:200].tolist())
    tf = set(np.argsort(np.bincount(dst, minlength=Nr))[::-1][:200].tolist())
    print(f"REAL congelamiento mitad->final = {len(th & tf)/200:.2f}")
    print(f"REAL edad mediana de pilares = {np.median(sorted(tf))/Nr:.3f} del corpus")

elif fase == "bosque1":
    N = 8000; res = []; k = 0; t0 = time.time()
    for pf in (0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8):
        for pn in (0.05, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6):
            if pf + pn > 0.98: continue
            for nu in (0.003, 0.015, 0.06):
                for w in (0.4, 0.9):
                    s, d = genesis(N, 0.0, pf, pn, nu, w, seed=1000+k)
                    ph = medir(N, s, d, 9000+k)
                    res.append((pf, pn, nu, w) + ph + (dist(ph), clasificar(*ph))); k += 1
    print(f"bosque1: {k} universos ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s) | fases:", Counter(r[9] for r in res))
    for r in sorted(res, key=lambda r: r[8])[:6]:
        print(f"  {r[0]:.2f} {r[1]:.2f} {r[2]:.3f} {r[3]:.1f} | {r[4]:+.2f} {r[5]:.2f} {r[6]:.2f} {r[7]:.2f} | d*={r[8]:.2f}")

elif fase == "bosque2":
    N = 16000; res = []; k = 0; t0 = time.time()
    for pg in (0.15, 0.25, 0.35):
        for pf in (0.30, 0.40, 0.50):
            for pn in (0.10, 0.20):
                if pg+pf+pn > 0.95: continue
                for nu in (0.002, 0.006):
                    s, d = genesis(N, pg, pf, pn, nu, 0.65, seed=5000+k)
                    ph = medir(N, s, d, 7000+k)
                    res.append((pg, pf, pn, nu) + ph + (dist(ph),)); k += 1
    print(f"bosque2: {k} universos ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s)")
    for r in sorted(res, key=lambda r: r[8])[:6]:
        print(f"  {r[0]:.2f} {r[1]:.2f} {r[2]:.2f} {r[3]:.3f} | {r[4]:+.2f} {r[5]:.2f} {r[6]:.2f} {r[7]:.2f} | d*={r[8]:.2f}")
    b = sorted(res, key=lambda r: r[8])[0]
    print("estabilidad del mejor (3 semillas):")
    for sd in (11, 22, 33):
        s, d = genesis(N, b[0], b[1], b[2], b[3], 0.65, seed=sd)
        ph = medir(N, s, d, sd+100)
        print(f"  zipf={ph[0]:+.2f} rho={ph[1]:.2f} q={ph[2]:.2f} p1={ph[3]:.2f} d*={dist(ph):.2f}")

elif fase == "ablacion":
    N = 16000; B = (0.35, 0.50, 0.10)
    print("ablaciones sobre (pg=.35 pf=.50 pn=.10 nu=.002 w=.65):")
    for nombre, p in [("completo      ", B), ("sin gramatica ", (0, .50, .10)),
                      ("sin fama      ", (.35, 0, .10)), ("sin naves     ", (.35, .50, 0))]:
        s, d = genesis(N, p[0], p[1], p[2], 0.002, 0.65, seed=333)
        ph = medir(N, s, d, 444)
        print(f"  {nombre}: zipf={ph[0]:+.2f} rho={ph[1]:.2f} q={ph[2]:.2f} p1={ph[3]:.2f} d*={dist(ph):.2f}")

elif fase == "tiempo":
    s, d = genesis(36000, 0.35, 0.50, 0.10, 0.002, 0.65, seed=777)
    top_early = None
    for T in (4000, 8000, 16000, 24000, 36000):
        sel = s < T
        ph = medir(T, s[sel], d[sel], 555+T)
        ind = np.bincount(d[sel], minlength=T)
        top = set(np.argsort(ind)[::-1][:200].tolist())
        if top_early is None: top_early = top
        print(f"  T={T:5d}: zipf={ph[0]:+.2f} rho={ph[1]:.2f} q={ph[2]:.2f} p1={ph[3]:.2f}"
              f" | pilares de T=4000 reinando: {len(top & top_early)/200:.2f}")
else:
    print(__doc__)

D.7 — la_telarana_experimentos.py

El viaje de LA TELARAÑA (cap. 33), recuperado íntegro del registro de la sesión: comunidades, PageRank + caminata de 6 M de pasos + Kac real, naves reales del archivo, AUC con empates, y el tejido del mapa interactivo telarana.html.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
LA TELARANA — experimentos completos, recuperados verbatim del registro de la
sesion fundadora (11-jul-2026). Requiere los intermedios de LA CATEDRAL en /tmp
(cat_src.npy, cat_dst.npy, cat_labels.txt, cat_indeg.npy, cat_depth.npy) y
metamath/set.mm para las naves reales. Fases (en el orden en que se corrieron):

  python3 la_telarana_experimentos.py A       # comunidades + PageRank + caminata 6M + Kac real + supergrafo
  python3 la_telarana_experimentos.py ABIS    # comunidades del contenido (sin 200 pilares)
  python3 la_telarana_experimentos.py NAVES   # parsear los estandartes reales del archivo -> /tmp/secciones.pkl
  python3 la_telarana_experimentos.py SUPER   # supergrafo de naves reales + primera AUC
  python3 la_telarana_experimentos.py AUC     # AUC corregida con empates (rankdata)
  python3 la_telarana_experimentos.py TEJIDO  # tejer telarana.html (mapa interactivo autocontenido)

La salida de referencia esta en la_telarana_resultados.txt.
"""
import sys

def fase_A():
    # LA TELARANA - BLOQUE A: comunidades, caminatas millonarias, Kac real, supergrafo
    import numpy as np, time
    from collections import defaultdict, Counter
    t0=time.time()
    src = np.load("/tmp/cat_src.npy"); dst = np.load("/tmp/cat_dst.npy")
    labels = [l.split("\t")[0] for l in open("/tmp/cat_labels.txt")]
    N = 50435; M = len(src)

    # ===== comunidades por propagacion de etiquetas (grafo no dirigido) =====
    vecinos = defaultdict(list)
    for e in range(M):
        s, d = int(src[e]), int(dst[e])
        vecinos[s].append(d); vecinos[d].append(s)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
    lab = np.arange(N)
    orden = np.arange(N)
    for sweep in range(8):
        rng.shuffle(orden); cambios = 0
        for i in orden:
            vs = vecinos.get(int(i))
            if not vs: continue
            c = Counter(lab[v] for v in vs)
            nuevo = c.most_common(1)[0][0]
            if nuevo != lab[i]: lab[i] = nuevo; cambios += 1
        if cambios < N//500: break
    comus = Counter(lab.tolist())
    grandes = [c for c,n in comus.items() if n >= 100]
    print(f"A1 comunidades ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s): {len(comus)} totales, {len(grandes)} con >=100 piedras; la mayor = {comus.most_common(1)[0][1]}")
    # modularidad (aprox, no dirigida)
    deg = np.zeros(N)
    for e in range(M):
        deg[src[e]] += 1; deg[dst[e]] += 1
    m2 = 2.0*M
    Q = 0.0
    for e in range(M):
        if lab[src[e]] == lab[dst[e]]: Q += 1.0/M
    suma_deg = defaultdict(float)
    for i in range(N): suma_deg[lab[i]] += deg[i]
    Q -= sum((sd/m2)**2 for sd in suma_deg.values())
    print(f"A1 modularidad Q = {Q:.3f}")

    # ===== PageRank por potencias + caminata literal de millones de pasos =====
    alpha = 0.85
    sal = np.bincount(src, minlength=N).astype(float)
    pr = np.ones(N)/N
    for it in range(60):
        nuevo = np.zeros(N)
        np.add.at(nuevo, dst, alpha*pr[src]/np.maximum(sal[src],1))
        nuevo += (1-alpha)/N + alpha*pr[sal==0].sum()/N
        pr = nuevo
    top_pr = np.argsort(pr)[::-1][:6]
    print(f"A2 PageRank (gravedad de la telarana): " + ", ".join(f"{labels[i]}({pr[i]:.4f})" for i in top_pr))
    # caminata literal: 6 millones de pasos con reinicio
    por_fuente = defaultdict(list)
    for e in range(M): por_fuente[int(src[e])].append(int(dst[e]))
    fuentes = list(por_fuente.keys())
    visitas = np.zeros(N, dtype=np.int64)
    ret_obj = int(top_pr[0]); retornos = []; ult_visita = None
    rng2 = np.random.default_rng(99)
    pos = int(rng2.integers(N)); PASOS = 6_000_000
    saltos_u = rng2.random(PASOS); elecciones = rng2.random(PASOS)
    for t in range(PASOS):
        if saltos_u[t] > alpha or pos not in por_fuente:
            pos = int(elecciones[t]*N)
        else:
            vs = por_fuente[pos]
            pos = vs[int(elecciones[t]*len(vs))]
        visitas[pos] += 1
        if pos == ret_obj:
            if ult_visita is not None: retornos.append(t-ult_visita)
            ult_visita = t
    emp = visitas/PASOS
    corr = np.corrcoef(emp, pr)[0,1]
    print(f"A2 caminata literal: 6,000,000 pasos ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s) | corr(visitas, PageRank) = {corr:.4f}")
    print(f"A3 KAC en la telarana real: retorno medio a '{labels[ret_obj]}' = {np.mean(retornos):.1f} pasos | 1/pi = {1/pr[ret_obj]:.1f} ({len(retornos)} retornos)")

    # ===== supergrafo de comunidades para la telarana visual =====
    top_com = [c for c,_ in comus.most_common(60)]
    cidx = {c:i for i,c in enumerate(top_com)}
    C = len(top_com)
    masa = np.zeros(C); flujo = np.zeros((C,C))
    epoca = np.zeros(C); prof_c = np.zeros(C)
    depth = np.load('/tmp/cat_depth.npy')
    for i in range(N):
        c = cidx.get(lab[i])
        if c is not None:
            masa[c] += 1; epoca[c] += i/N; prof_c[c] += depth[i]
    epoca /= np.maximum(masa,1); prof_c /= np.maximum(masa,1)
    for e in range(M):
        a, b = cidx.get(lab[src[e]]), cidx.get(lab[dst[e]])
        if a is not None and b is not None and a != b:
            flujo[a,b] += 1
    # nombres: los 3 miembros mas citados de cada comunidad
    indeg = np.load('/tmp/cat_indeg.npy')
    nombres = []
    for c in top_com:
        miembros = [i for i in range(N) if lab[i]==c]
        tops = sorted(miembros, key=lambda i: -indeg[i])[:3]
        nombres.append(" ".join(labels[i] for i in tops))
    np.savez('/tmp/telarana.npz', masa=masa, flujo=flujo, epoca=epoca, prof=prof_c,
             nombres=np.array(nombres, dtype=object), Q=Q, ncom=len(comus))
    print(f"A4 supergrafo: {C} naves mayores, masa total {int(masa.sum())} piedras ({100*masa.sum()/N:.0f}% del edificio)")
    print("A4 las 5 naves mayores:", " | ".join(f"{nombres[i]} ({int(masa[i])})" for i in np.argsort(masa)[::-1][:5]))

def fase_ABIS():
    # A-bis: comunidades del CONTENIDO (sin los 200 pilares) + supergrafo real
    import numpy as np, time
    from collections import defaultdict, Counter
    t0=time.time()
    src = np.load("/tmp/cat_src.npy"); dst = np.load("/tmp/cat_dst.npy")
    labels = [l.split("\t")[0] for l in open("/tmp/cat_labels.txt")]
    indeg = np.load('/tmp/cat_indeg.npy'); depth = np.load('/tmp/cat_depth.npy')
    N = 50435; M = len(src)
    pilares = set(np.argsort(indeg)[::-1][:200].tolist())

    vecinos = defaultdict(list)
    for e in range(M):
        s, d = int(src[e]), int(dst[e])
        if s in pilares or d in pilares: continue
        vecinos[s].append(d); vecinos[d].append(s)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
    lab = np.arange(N)
    orden = np.array(sorted(vecinos.keys()))
    for sweep in range(12):
        rng.shuffle(orden); cambios = 0
        for i in orden:
            vs = vecinos[int(i)]
            c = Counter(lab[v] for v in vs)
            nuevo = c.most_common(1)[0][0]
            if nuevo != lab[i]: lab[i] = nuevo; cambios += 1
        if cambios < len(orden)//500: break
    comus = Counter(lab[list(orden)].tolist())
    grandes = comus.most_common(80)
    print(f"B1 comunidades de contenido ({time.time()-t0:.0f}s): {len(comus)} totales; >=200 piedras: {sum(1 for _,n in comus.items() if n>=200)}")
    # modularidad sobre el grafo de contenido
    degc = np.zeros(N)
    Mc = 0
    for e in range(M):
        s, d = int(src[e]), int(dst[e])
        if s in pilares or d in pilares: continue
        degc[s]+=1; degc[d]+=1; Mc+=1
    Q = 0.0
    for e in range(M):
        s, d = int(src[e]), int(dst[e])
        if s in pilares or d in pilares: continue
        if lab[s]==lab[d]: Q += 1.0/Mc
    sd = defaultdict(float)
    for i in orden: sd[lab[i]] += degc[i]
    Q -= sum((x/(2*Mc))**2 for x in sd.values())
    print(f"B1 modularidad del contenido Q = {Q:.3f}")

    top_com = [c for c,n in grandes if n >= 200][:48]
    cidx = {c:i for i,c in enumerate(top_com)}
    C = len(top_com)
    masa = np.zeros(C); epoca = np.zeros(C); prof_c = np.zeros(C)
    miembros_por = defaultdict(list)
    for i in orden:
        c = cidx.get(lab[i])
        if c is not None:
            masa[c]+=1; epoca[c]+=i/N; prof_c[c]+=depth[i]; miembros_por[c].append(int(i))
    epoca/=np.maximum(masa,1); prof_c/=np.maximum(masa,1)
    flujo = np.zeros((C,C)); a_pilar = np.zeros(C)
    for e in range(M):
        s, d = int(src[e]), int(dst[e])
        cs, cd = cidx.get(lab[s]), cidx.get(lab[d])
        if cs is not None and d in pilares: a_pilar[cs]+=1
        if cs is not None and cd is not None and cs!=cd: flujo[cs,cd]+=1
    nombres = []
    for c in range(C):
        tops = sorted(miembros_por[c], key=lambda i: -indeg[i])[:3]
        nombres.append(" ".join(labels[i] for i in tops))
    print(f"B2 supergrafo: {C} naves (masa {int(masa.sum())} = {100*masa.sum()/N:.0f}% del edificio), hilos inter-nave: {int((flujo>0).sum())}")
    print("B2 las 10 naves mayores:")
    for i in np.argsort(masa)[::-1][:10]:
        print(f"   {int(masa[i]):6d} piedras | epoca {epoca[i]:.2f} | prof {prof_c[i]:.0f} | {nombres[i]}")
    np.savez('/tmp/telarana2.npz', masa=masa, flujo=flujo, epoca=epoca, prof=prof_c, apilar=a_pilar,
             nombres=np.array(nombres, dtype=object), Q=Q, ncom=len(comus), C=C)

def fase_NAVES():
    # Las naves REALES: parsear los estandartes de seccion de set.mm y medir la telarana
    import numpy as np, re, time
    from collections import defaultdict, Counter
    t0=time.time()
    raw = open("metamath/set.mm", encoding="utf-8").read()
    # recorrer en orden: comentarios (posibles estandartes) y declaraciones $a/$p
    pat = re.compile(r"\$\(.*?\$\)|(\S+)\s+\$([ap])\s", re.DOTALL)
    sec_actual = "PREAMBULO"; parte_actual = "INICIO"
    secciones = []   # por statement: (parte, seccion)
    nivel_pat = [
        (re.compile(r"\n *#{10,}"), "parte"),
        (re.compile(r"\n *={10,}|\n *=-=-"), "seccion"),
    ]
    n_st = 0
    for m in pat.finditer(raw):
        if m.group(1) is None:
            com = m.group(0)
            es_parte = re.search(r"#\*#\*|\n *#{10,}", com)
            es_sec = re.search(r"=-=-|-=-=|\n *={10,}", com)
            if es_parte or es_sec:
                lineas = [l.strip() for l in com.split("\n")]
                titulo = None
                for l in lineas[1:]:
                    ll = l.strip("$( )#*=-.~ ").strip()
                    if len(ll) > 3 and not re.fullmatch(r"[#*=\-.~ ]+", l):
                        titulo = ll; break
                if titulo:
                    if es_parte: parte_actual = titulo[:60]; sec_actual = titulo[:60]
                    else: sec_actual = titulo[:60]
        else:
            secciones.append((parte_actual, sec_actual)); n_st += 1
    print(f"declaraciones asignadas: {n_st} (esperadas 50435)")
    partes = Counter(p for p,s in secciones)
    print(f"partes detectadas: {len(partes)}")
    for p, n in partes.most_common(14): print(f"   {n:6d}  {p}")
    secs = Counter(s for p,s in secciones)
    print(f"secciones detectadas: {len(secs)}; con >=300 piedras: {sum(1 for _,n in secs.items() if n>=300)}")
    import pickle
    with open('/tmp/secciones.pkl','wb') as f: pickle.dump(secciones, f)
    print(f"({time.time()-t0:.0f}s)")

def fase_SUPER():
    # TELARANA: supergrafo de partes reales + prediccion de hilos (AUC)
    import numpy as np, pickle, time, math
    from collections import defaultdict, Counter
    t0=time.time()
    src = np.load("/tmp/cat_src.npy"); dst = np.load("/tmp/cat_dst.npy")
    labels = [l.split("\t")[0] for l in open("/tmp/cat_labels.txt")]
    indeg = np.load('/tmp/cat_indeg.npy'); depth = np.load('/tmp/cat_depth.npy')
    secciones = pickle.load(open('/tmp/secciones.pkl','rb'))
    N = 50435; M = len(src)
    pilares = set(np.argsort(indeg)[::-1][:200].tolist())
    partes = [p for p,s in secciones]
    cnt = Counter(partes)
    top_p = [p for p,n in cnt.most_common(44)]
    pidx = {p:i for i,p in enumerate(top_p)}
    C = len(top_p)
    pid = np.array([pidx.get(p, -1) for p in partes], dtype=np.int32)

    # metricas por nave + flujos (solo aristas de contenido para flujo tematico)
    masa = np.zeros(C); epoca = np.zeros(C); prof = np.zeros(C); pr_masa = np.zeros(C)
    # pagerank ya calculado antes? recalcular rapido
    alpha=0.85; sal = np.bincount(src, minlength=N).astype(float)
    pr = np.ones(N)/N
    for it in range(50):
        nuevo = np.zeros(N)
        np.add.at(nuevo, dst, alpha*pr[src]/np.maximum(sal[src],1))
        nuevo += (1-alpha)/N + alpha*pr[sal==0].sum()/N
        pr = nuevo
    for i in range(N):
        c = pid[i]
        if c>=0: masa[c]+=1; epoca[c]+=i/N; prof[c]+=depth[i]; pr_masa[c]+=pr[i]
    epoca/=np.maximum(masa,1); prof/=np.maximum(masa,1)
    flujo = np.zeros((C,C)); intra=0; inter=0; a_pilar=0; tot_cont=0
    for e in range(M):
        s, d = int(src[e]), int(dst[e])
        if d in pilares:
            a_pilar+=1; continue
        tot_cont+=1
        cs, cd = pid[s], pid[d]
        if cs<0 or cd<0: continue
        if cs==cd: intra+=1
        else: inter+=1; flujo[cs,cd]+=1
    print(f"T1 aristas: {M/1e6:.2f}M | al huso (200 pilares): {a_pilar/M:.3f} | contenido: {tot_cont/M:.3f}")
    print(f"T1 localidad de las naves: intra-nave = {intra/(intra+inter):.3f} de las citas de contenido con nave asignada")
    # modularidad de la particion real (grafo de contenido, no dirigido)
    degc = defaultdict(float); Mc=0; Qsum=0.0
    for e in range(M):
        s,d = int(src[e]), int(dst[e])
        if d in pilares or s in pilares: continue
        Mc+=1; degc[s]+=1; degc[d]+=1
        if pid[s]==pid[d] and pid[s]>=0: Qsum+=1
    sdeg = defaultdict(float)
    for i in range(N):
        if pid[i]>=0: sdeg[pid[i]] += degc.get(i,0)
    Q = Qsum/Mc - sum((x/(2*Mc))**2 for x in sdeg.values())
    print(f"T1 modularidad de la particion REAL (contenido): Q = {Q:.3f}")

    # ===== COMPLETAR NODOS: prediccion de hilos ocultos =====
    rng = np.random.default_rng(2027)
    # candidatos: aristas de contenido de teoremas tardios (src > 5000), ocultar 15000
    cont_idx = np.array([e for e in range(M) if int(dst[e]) not in pilares and src[e] > 5000])
    ocultas = rng.choice(cont_idx, size=15000, replace=False)
    oc_set = set(ocultas.tolist())
    # vecindarios sin las ocultas (no dirigido, contenido)
    vec = defaultdict(set)
    for e in range(M):
        if e in oc_set: continue
        s, d = int(src[e]), int(dst[e])
        vec[s].add(d); vec[d].add(s)
    gradon = {i: len(vec[i]) for i in vec}
    def score_par(t, l):
        # comunes ponderados Adamic-Adar + grado + misma nave
        comunes = vec[t] & vec.get(l, set())
        aa = sum(1.0/math.log(max(gradon.get(c,2),2)) for c in comunes)
        return aa, indeg[l], 1.0 if (pid[t]>=0 and pid[t]==pid[l]) else 0.0
    pos_pares = [(int(src[e]), int(dst[e])) for e in ocultas]
    neg_pares = []
    while len(neg_pares) < 15000:
        t = int(src[ocultas[len(neg_pares)%15000]])
        l = int(rng.integers(0, t))
        if l not in vec[t] and l not in pilares: neg_pares.append((t,l))
    def auc(scores_p, scores_n):
        todos = np.concatenate([scores_p, scores_n])
        r = todos.argsort().argsort()[:len(scores_p)].sum()
        n1, n2 = len(scores_p), len(scores_n)
        return (r - n1*(n1-1)/2)/(n1*n2)
    sp = np.array([score_par(*p) for p in pos_pares])
    sn = np.array([score_par(*p) for p in neg_pares])
    print(f"\nT2 PREDICCION DE HILOS (15000 ocultos vs 15000 negativos; {2*15000} pares puntuados):")
    print(f"   AUC Adamic-Adar (vecinos comunes) = {auc(sp[:,0], sn[:,0]):.4f}")
    print(f"   AUC grado del destino (fama)      = {auc(sp[:,1], sn[:,1]):.4f}")
    print(f"   AUC misma nave                    = {auc(sp[:,2], sn[:,2]):.4f}")
    comb_p = sp[:,0] + 0.001*sp[:,1] + 2*sp[:,2]
    comb_n = sn[:,0] + 0.001*sn[:,1] + 2*sn[:,2]
    print(f"   AUC combinado                     = {auc(comb_p, comb_n):.4f}")

    nombres_cortos = []
    for p in top_p:
        n = p.replace("ZF Set Theory - ","ZF: ").replace("Mathbox for ","Mathbox: ").replace("start with the ","").replace("add the ","")
        nombres_cortos.append(n[:38])
    np.savez('/tmp/telarana_final.npz', masa=masa, flujo=flujo, epoca=epoca, prof=prof, prm=pr_masa,
             nombres=np.array(nombres_cortos, dtype=object), Q=Q, C=C)
    print(f"\n({time.time()-t0:.0f}s) supergrafo final: {C} naves, guardado")

def fase_AUC():
    # AUC corregida con manejo de empates (rankdata average)
    import numpy as np, pickle, math
    from collections import defaultdict
    from scipy.stats import rankdata
    src = np.load("/tmp/cat_src.npy"); dst = np.load("/tmp/cat_dst.npy")
    indeg = np.load('/tmp/cat_indeg.npy')
    secciones = pickle.load(open('/tmp/secciones.pkl','rb'))
    from collections import Counter
    partes = [p for p,s in secciones]; cnt = Counter(partes)
    pidx = {p:i for i,p in enumerate([p for p,n in cnt.most_common(44)])}
    pid = np.array([pidx.get(p,-1) for p in partes], dtype=np.int32)
    N = 50435; M = len(src)
    pilares = set(np.argsort(indeg)[::-1][:200].tolist())
    rng = np.random.default_rng(2027)
    cont_idx = np.array([e for e in range(M) if int(dst[e]) not in pilares and src[e] > 5000])
    ocultas = rng.choice(cont_idx, size=15000, replace=False)
    oc_set = set(ocultas.tolist())
    vec = defaultdict(set)
    for e in range(M):
        if e in oc_set: continue
        s, d = int(src[e]), int(dst[e])
        vec[s].add(d); vec[d].add(s)
    gr = {i: len(v) for i,v in vec.items()}
    def feats(t, l):
        com = vec[t] & vec.get(l, set())
        aa = sum(1.0/math.log(max(gr.get(c,2),2)) for c in com)
        return aa, indeg[l], 1.0 if (pid[t]>=0 and pid[t]==pid[l]) else 0.0
    pos = [(int(src[e]), int(dst[e])) for e in ocultas]
    neg = []
    while len(neg) < 15000:
        t = int(src[ocultas[len(neg)%15000]]); l = int(rng.integers(0,t))
        if l not in vec[t] and l not in pilares: neg.append((t,l))
    sp = np.array([feats(*p) for p in pos]); sn = np.array([feats(*p) for p in neg])
    def auc_ok(a, b):
        r = rankdata(np.concatenate([a,b]))
        return (r[:len(a)].sum() - len(a)*(len(a)+1)/2)/(len(a)*len(b))
    print("AUC corregidas (empates promediados):")
    print(f"   Adamic-Adar   = {auc_ok(sp[:,0], sn[:,0]):.4f}")
    print(f"   fama (grado)  = {auc_ok(sp[:,1], sn[:,1]):.4f}")
